presets.template:
# Soft Frosted Glass Icon Objects Template

Per Pass 6 of `promptbase-style-cloner/references/template-extraction-rubric.md`, this style is hyperreal-product/material-fidelity; the prompt skeleton is delivered as a **JSON spec** wrapped in a short prose intro. JSON beats prose on translucent-material binding (frosted vs glossy vs polished is a known failure axis for `gpt-image-2`, and the JSON keys hold the rendering pins).

## Required invariants (verbatim — reproduce in every prompt)

1. **2:3 portrait canvas.** Output size `1024 x 1536` PNG (or proportional). Background extends to all four edges as pure flat white `#FFFFFF`.
2. **Exactly one hero object,** centered horizontally, optical-centered vertically (sits slightly above geometric mid-height so the soft contact shadow has room beneath it).
3. **Material is translucent frosted glass with a satin (not glossy) finish.** Soft inner glow at the core, slightly lighter translucent rim. No specular pinpoints. No mirror highlights. No caustics.
4. **Surface highlight** is a soft diffuse top-left bloom only. Light source is large, soft, slightly above and to the upper-left of the object.
5. **Color body** is one primary hue or a smooth two-color vertical gradient. Multi-band rainbows are allowed only when the subject itself is a rainbow.
6. **Edges are generously rounded.** No sharp corners. Chunky, toy-like proportions. Forms read as inflated jelly / silicone toy, not as crystal.
7. **Shadow is a small, soft, low-contrast contact shadow** directly beneath the object. No cast shadow on any side, no hard-edge shadow, no ambient occlusion ring.
8. **Camera framing** is slight 3/4 isometric for volumetric objects (cube, joystick, vehicle, gadget) or near-frontal for radially symmetric objects (flower, face, planet, helmet, fruit slice). The choice is derived from the subject geometry, not from a user slot.
9. **No text. No watermark. No seller signature. No QR code. No price tag. No callouts. No frame, no border.**
10. **Subject occupies ~35-45% of frame width.** Generous white margin on all four sides.

## Variable slots

| Slot | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `{ICON_SUBJECT}` | string, one concrete noun phrase | required | e.g. "wireless headphones", "umbrella", "coffee mug with steam", "rocket ship", "house with chimney" |
| `{PRIMARY_HUE}` | string color name OR vertical two-color gradient | required | e.g. "ice blue", "honey yellow", "coral red", "vertical pink-to-lavender gradient" |
| `{ACCENT_HUE}` | string color name | optional | only when the subject has a clearly secondary component (a button, a stick, a knob); omit otherwise |

## Prompt skeleton (engine input)

The skeleton below is the literal engine input. Replace `{...}` slots and submit verbatim.

````
Render a single hyperreal 3D icon-object in the "Soft Frosted Glass" style. Follow the JSON specification exactly. Do not add text, watermarks, or extra decorations.

```json
{
  "canvas": {
    "aspect": "2:3 portrait",
    "size_px": "1024x1536",
    "background": "flat pure white #FFFFFF, no gradient, no texture, no scene, edge-to-edge"
  },
  "subject": {
    "noun": "{ICON_SUBJECT}",
    "count": 1,
    "framing": "centered horizontally, optical center slightly above geometric midline",
    "size_in_frame": "occupies 35-45% of frame width, with generous white margin on all sides",
    "camera": "slight 3/4 isometric angle if the subject is volumetric (cubes, gadgets, vehicles); near-frontal if the subject is radially symmetric (faces, fruits, flowers, weather symbols). Choose by geometry.",
    "proportions": "chunky, inflated, toy-like; corners generously rounded; no thin sharp edges; reads like a silicone toy more than crystal"
  },
  "material": {
    "type": "translucent frosted glass",
    "finish": "soft satin, NOT glossy, NOT mirror-polished, NOT clear-resin",
    "translucency": "denser core, slightly lighter translucent rim where light passes through",
    "inner_glow": "soft, ambient, low-intensity",
    "highlights": "single soft diffuse bloom on the upper-left third of the object; NO specular pinpoints, NO caustics, NO sharp reflections",
    "color_body": "{PRIMARY_HUE}, applied as a smooth fill or a smooth vertical gradient; no banding, no posterization",
    "accent_color_if_subfeature": "{ACCENT_HUE}"
  },
  "lighting": {
    "key": "large soft area light from upper-left, slightly above the object",
    "fill": "even ambient, neutral white",
    "rim": "none beyond what the translucent rim naturally produces",
    "shadow": "small soft contact shadow directly beneath the object, low contrast, short, blurred; NOT a long cast shadow, NOT a hard outline"
  },
  "rendering": {
    "engine_hint": "physically based 3D render with subsurface scattering tuned to read as satin frosted glass / jelly",
    "edges": "generously filleted, no sharp corners, no thin straight wireframes",
    "quality": "studio product render, hyperreal, sharp focus on the subject"
  },
  "negative_directives": [
    "no text of any kind",
    "no watermark or signature",
    "no callouts, labels, badges, QR codes",
    "no glossy varnish or high-shine plastic look",
    "no clear-resin or crystal look — must be FROSTED satin",
    "no studio environment, no floor plane, no backdrop seam, no horizon",
    "no patterned or textured background; background is flat pure #FFFFFF",
    "no multiple instances of the subject, no group shot, no pattern repeat",
    "no hard cast shadow, no ambient occlusion ring around the object"
  ]
}
```
````

## Notes on the JSON wrap

- The triple-backtick `json` fence inside the prompt is intentional — `gpt-image-2` honors structured prompts noticeably better when the spec block is fenced (verified pattern from `gpt-image-2-techniques/references/json-spec.md` and corroborated by @tadasgedgaudas's head-to-head, 1,090 likes on X).
- Keep the negative directives short and absolute. Each one corresponds to a known `gpt-image-2` failure mode for this style: it loves to add glossy varnish, a studio floor, or a long cast shadow when given a hyperreal product brief.
- If the model still produces a glossy result, append the reinforcement clause: `"Repeat: the surface is satin frosted, like soft etched ice or beach glass, NOT glossy or polished."`

## Failure modes seen in practice

- **Glossy varnish drift.** Mitigation: keep the `finish` value and the negative directive both phrased. Surfacing the word "satin" twice helps.
- **Long cast shadow.** Mitigation: the explicit `shadow` spec and the matching negative directive.
- **Studio backdrop sneaks in.** Mitigation: "edge-to-edge" `#FFFFFF` and the matching negative directive.
- **Multiple icons in a grid.** Mitigation: `count: 1` plus the negative directive against pattern repeats.

presets.template:
# Vintage Grit Sticker Sheet Template

Source: https://promptbase.com/prompt/vintage-grit-sticker-sheet-generator-2 (paywalled, by @dastype, model tag GPT-5.4+IMAGE-2). Template reconstructed from 5 public preview images via direct multimodal visual analysis.

## Required invariants (verbatim — reproduce in every prompt)

1. **1:1 square sheet.** Output dimensions 1024×1024 pixels.
2. **Dense mosaic of 25–35 framed mini-poster sticker tiles** filling the canvas edge-to-edge. Mixed-size grid:
   - 2–4 hero rectangular tiles, ~25–35% of sheet height each
   - 6–10 mid rectangular/strip tiles, ~12–18% each
   - 10–18 small square or rectangular corner stickers, ~6–10% each
3. **Aged cream/tan paper background** showing through gutters, with grunge texture, dust speckle, edge wear, faint halftone dot screen overlay, and uneven ink-bleed at tile borders.
4. **Strict 3-color palette: black ink, crimson/blood red accent, aged cream paper.** No blue, no green, no yellow, no photographic color. Red is used for select headlines, accent shapes, katakana glyphs, and small graphic flourishes only — never as a fill ground.
5. **Engraved / etched chiaroscuro illustration** on every hero tile: heavy crosshatch and stippled shadows, theatrical rim or silhouette lighting, vintage broadsheet / plague-pamphlet aesthetic. No soft photographic gradients.
6. **Every tile has a black border frame** (single thick block, double pinstripe, or ornamental rule). Frames touch or near-touch adjacent frames with a thin paper gutter.
7. **Mixed bold typography per tile.** Hero headlines: condensed slab serif or block sans, all caps, 2–4 words, set black on cream or white on a black band. Subheads: small-caps Spanish proverb in 4–12 words, italic or condensed, often anchored to the bottom rule. Optional decorative red Japanese katakana glyph cluster on 1–2 tiles per sheet.
8. **Spanish-language headlines and proverbs by default.** Register: punk, occult, streetwise, philosophical aphorism. Lock text accuracy by quoting every {HEADLINE_N} and {SUBHEAD_N} verbatim in the prompt.
9. **Recurring motif library** drawn from: hooded figures, animal skulls (bull / ram / deer / goat), Anonymous V mask, gas mask, plague doctor, samurai with katana, anthropomorphic cat or owl in three-piece suit, raised fist, occult sigils and pentagrams, religious figures (Madonna, monk), hands holding daggers/keys/all-seeing-eye, wolves, ravens.
10. **No watermark, no seller signature, no QR codes, no prices, no PromptBase logo.** Output is the sheet only.

## Variable slots

| Slot | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| {THEME} | string, single phrase | "rebellion and street wisdom" | overarching mood |
| {LANGUAGE} | string | "Spanish" | "Spanish" \| "English" \| "Latin" \| "Japanese romaji" |
| {ACCENT_LANGUAGE} | string | "Japanese katakana" | optional decorative script for 1–2 red glyph clusters; set to "none" to skip |
| {HEADLINE_LIST} | array of 4–8 strings, 2–4 words each, ALL CAPS | required | hero panel headlines, quoted verbatim |
| {SUBHEAD_LIST} | array of 4–8 strings, 4–12 words each | required | proverb taglines pairing 1:1 with headlines |
| {MOTIF_LIST} | array of 4–8 strings | required | hero subjects (e.g. "hooded hacker at laptop", "bull skull crowned with thorns") |
| {SHEET_TITLE} | string, optional | "" | rare central feature panel headline; leave blank to skip |
| {TILE_COUNT_TARGET} | integer | 30 | range 25–35; pushes density |

## Prompt skeleton

presets.template:
# Custom Playing Card Designs Template

Derived from 9 individual previews on the Promptbase listing. The seller's prompt is paywalled; this template is reconstructed from public previews via the `promptbase-style-cloner` reverse-prompt protocol.

## Required invariants (verbatim — reproduce in every prompt)

1. **2:3 portrait card. Output size 1024×1536.** A single playing card fills the frame, centered, on a clean off-white or transparent surround. Subtle rounded corners on the card itself; thin black outline frames the card.
2. **One hero subject only.** {CHARACTER_SUBJECT} shown from mid-chest up. No background scenery, no environment, no second figure. White card face behind the hero.
3. **Double-ended "two-headed" symmetry.** The top half is the hero upright; the bottom half is the same hero rotated 180°, mirrored across a horizontal line crossing the lower torso. The mirror line is hidden by a stylized divider — a sash, a banner, a curved strap, crossed weapons, or a sharp diagonal cut. Hands, props, and clothing details on the top half are repeated, rotated, on the bottom half.
4. **Index pips: rank letter then suit glyph, top-left and bottom-right.** Top-left corner: `{RANK}` letter (large, bold serif), small `{SUIT}` glyph stacked directly underneath. Bottom-right corner: same pair, rotated 180°. Color is suit-locked: **red** for ♥/♦, **black** for ♠/♣. No pips on top-right or bottom-left corners.
5. **Decorative inner border** on all four edges of the card. A repeating geometric band of red diamonds and black diamond/triangle shapes with small chevron flourishes at the four corners. The border separates the hero from the outer white card margin. The border uses only red, black, and white.
6. **Flat-vector ink illustration.** Uniform heavy black outline. No gradients, no soft shading, no photographic lighting, no airbrush. Solid color fills only. Detail comes from line work, not from shading.
7. **Palette locked to red + black + white**, plus an optional single accent hue `{ACCENT_COLOR}` (gold, cyan, brown, slate, neon-pink, etc.). Never more than 4 distinct hues. Skin tones are stylized (often white, light pink, or implied via outline).
8. **White card body** behind the hero. No scene, no environment, no texture, no gradient.
9. **Card edge.** Thin black stroke around the full perimeter. Card corners are gently rounded. A small white margin separates the card edge from the decorative inner border.
10. **No text other than the two rank pips.** No watermark, no seller signature, no banner copy, no caption, no QR code, no price tag, no website URL.
11. **Text accuracy.** The two `{RANK}` letters render legibly and identically. The two `{SUIT}` glyphs are the same shape and the same color. The bottom-right pair is rotated 180°.

## Variable slots

| Slot | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `{RANK}` | enum: A, K, Q, J, 10, 9, 8, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2 | — | required. Determines the letter at both pips. |
| `{SUIT}` | enum: spades, hearts, diamonds, clubs | — | required. Glyph + color follow suit. |
| `{CHARACTER_SUBJECT}` | string (1-6 words) | — | required. The archetype: "samurai ronin", "punk rock guitarist", "EOD bomb-disposal soldier", "chef", "cowboy outlaw", "hooded hacker", "knight in plate armor", "pirate captain", "astronaut". |
| `{CLOTHING_AND_PROPS}` | string (free-form) | — | optional but encouraged. Wardrobe pieces and one or two props that anchor the silhouette. Example: "katana drawn in right hand, kunai belt across chest, mempo half-mask". |
| `{ACCENT_COLOR}` | string (color name) | none | optional. Single non-red/black/white hue used sparingly for metals, gemstones, or fabric trim. |

## Prompt skeleton

```
Flat vector illustration of a single 2:3 portrait playing card, output 1024×1536, the card centered on a clean white surround.

The card shows the {RANK} of {SUIT} as a double-ended ("two-headed") court card. A single character — {CHARACTER_SUBJECT} — is rendered from mid-chest up in the top half of the card, then mirrored and rotated 180 degrees in the bottom half. The mirror line crosses the lower torso, hidden by a stylized divider (sash, banner, curved strap, crossed props, or a sharp diagonal cut).

Wardrobe and props: {CLOTHING_AND_PROPS}. Hands and held objects on the top half are repeated, rotated, on the bottom half so the card reads identically when flipped.

Color palette is strictly red, black, and white{ACCENT_CLAUSE}. Solid color fills, no gradients, no soft shading, no airbrushing, no photographic lighting. Heavy uniform black outline on every shape. Detail comes from line work and pattern, not from rendering.

Index pips: at the top-left corner, render the rank letter "{RANK}" in a large bold serif typeface, color-locked to the suit (red for hearts and diamonds, black for spades and clubs), with a small matching {SUIT} suit symbol stacked directly beneath it. Repeat the same rank-and-suit pair, rotated 180 degrees, at the bottom-right corner. No pips on the other two corners.

A decorative inner border runs around all four edges of the card: a repeating geometric band of red diamonds and black triangles with small chevron flourishes at the four corners, using only red, black, and white. The border sits inside a thin white margin between itself and the card edge.

The card itself has a thin black outline and gently rounded corners. The card body behind the hero is solid white — no scenery, no environment, no second figure, no texture.

Do not render any text other than the two rank letters at the pips. No watermark, no signature, no caption, no QR code, no price, no website. The bottom-right rank+suit pair must be rotated 180 degrees so it reads upright when the card is flipped.

Style reference: classic flat-vector double-ended court card, clean ink work, limited color palette, symmetric mirror composition.
```

`{ACCENT_CLAUSE}` is filled at runtime as either the empty string (no accent) or `, plus a single accent color of {ACCENT_COLOR} used sparingly on metals, gemstones, or fabric trim`.

## Self-test demo subject

The canonical demo subject for the icon and regression test:

- `{RANK}` = `K`
- `{SUIT}` = `spades`
- `{CHARACTER_SUBJECT}` = `medieval knight in full plate armor`
- `{CLOTHING_AND_PROPS}` = `closed visor great helm, sword raised in right hand, gauntlet on left holding a heater shield`
- `{ACCENT_COLOR}` = `silver-gray steel`

This subject exercises every invariant: the visor + plate is heavy line work, the sword is a vertical anchor that aids the mirror, the helm reads upside-down well, and the spades suit forces the black pip color.

## Validation checklist (run after every generation)

- [ ] 2:3 portrait, full card visible
- [ ] One hero, mid-chest up, mirrored top/bottom
- [ ] Mirror divider present at lower torso
- [ ] Top-left pip: `{RANK}` over `{SUIT}` glyph, correct color
- [ ] Bottom-right pip: same pair, rotated 180°
- [ ] No pips on top-right or bottom-left
- [ ] Decorative red+black diamond border on all 4 edges
- [ ] Heavy black outline, flat fills, no gradients
- [ ] Palette ≤ 4 hues, dominated by red/black/white
- [ ] White card body, no scenery
- [ ] No text other than the two rank letters
- [ ] No watermark, no caption, no QR

# Cyberpunk Scifi Concept Art — Template

Reverse-engineered from the Promptbase listing "Cyberpunk Scifi Concept Art Game Designs" by @divdev. Eight previews were used in the triangulation corpus (preview-09 dropped after two consecutive codex-cli-subagent failures). Prompt format: **prose**. Aspect ratio: **1:1 (square 1024x1024)**.

## Invariants (every generation must satisfy all 12)

1. Single centered hero object.
2. Plain white studio background.
3. Clean professional game concept art.
4. Anime mecha industrial kitbash aesthetic.
5. Mostly orthographic hard-surface render.
6. Off-white armor over dark exposed mechanics.
7. Limited neutral body color with small warning accents.
8. Crisp dark technical outlines.
9. Airbrushed metallic shading.
10. High-density kitbash panels, bolts, seams.
11. Weathered scratches and chipped paint.
12. Small serial decals and caution labels.

## Variable slots

| Slot | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------|
| `HERO_SUBJECT` | string, 1-5 words | yes | `battle mecha exo-suit` | Main sci-fi hard-surface object (mecha, hover bike, drone, cybernetic heart, weapon). |
| `SUBJECT_VARIANT` | string, silhouette / subclass note | yes | `bulky armored frame with exposed hydraulic limbs` | Controls subject-specific silhouette, pose, distinctive modules. Keeps the isolated concept-art plate intact. |
| `VIEW_ANGLE` | enum string | yes | `near-orthographic three-quarter profile facing left` | Allowed: `orthographic side profile`, `near-orthographic three-quarter profile`, `three-quarter front product view`. |
| `PRIMARY_COLOR` | string color name | yes | `red` | Primary small accent on plates, sensors, lamps, warning marks, cylinders. Neutral off-white + dark mechanical base stays invariant. |
| `SECONDARY_COLOR` | string color name | yes | `orange` | Secondary tiny accent for caution marks, lights, fittings, hazard details. |
| `MECHANICAL_FOCUS` | string, comma-separated | yes | `exposed pistons, hydraulic cylinders, cable bundles, circular hubs` | Subject-specific exposed mechanisms that should carry the densest hard-surface detail. |
| `LABEL_TEXT` | string, 3-8 short stencil labels | yes | `MX-17, UNIT 04, CAUTION, NO STEP` | The ONLY visible text. Serials, caution labels, unit numbers, short pseudo-technical markings. |

## Decorations dropped (must NOT appear)

- Seller watermark `@divdev`
- QR codes
- Price tags
- Promptbase UI overlays
- Signatures
- External logos or brand marks
- Any text other than the contents of `LABEL_TEXT`

## Prompt skeleton (verbatim, ship as-is to gpt-image-2)

```
Create a clean professional game concept art render of {HERO_SUBJECT}, {SUBJECT_VARIANT}, shown in {VIEW_ANGLE}. Keep a single centered hero object isolated on a plain white studio background. Use anime mecha industrial kitbash aesthetic with mostly orthographic hard-surface render, off-white armor over dark exposed mechanics, and a limited neutral body color with small warning accents using {PRIMARY_COLOR} plus {SECONDARY_COLOR}. Add {MECHANICAL_FOCUS}: high-density kitbash panels, bolts, seams, exposed mechanical parts, weathered scratches and chipped paint, grime, rivets, vents, hatches, and worn edges. Finish with crisp dark technical outlines and airbrushed metallic shading with sharp hard-surface panel edges. Add small serial decals and caution labels reading only {LABEL_TEXT}. No environment, no hands, no rider, no character unless it is the hero subject, no border, no watermark, no signature, no QR code, no price tag, no Promptbase UI overlay, no external logo, no text other than {LABEL_TEXT}. 1:1 square framing, centered hero
```

## Backend call (canonical)

```bash
~/.agents/skills/image-gen-cli/scripts/generate_image_via_codex_cli.sh \
  --prompt "$(filled-skeleton)" \
  --output "<absolute output path>.png" \
  --quality high \
  --size "square 1024x1024 PNG"
```

For the self-test icon, swap `--quality high` for `--quality low`.

# Felttip Character Napkin Doodles Template

Triangulated from 9 Promptbase previews (`@promptplazastore`, paywalled, gpt-image-2). Format selected: `prose-style-deviation` — the polish-prior of gpt-image-2 is the dominant failure mode for napkin-doodle aesthetics, and the tail-clause negation is what keeps the marker bleed and the hand-jitter in.

## Required invariants (verbatim — reproduce in every prompt)

1. Vertical 2:3 preview. Output size `1024x1536` PNG.
2. Top-down flat-lay framing, napkin fills ~85% of the vertical frame.
3. Single centered napkin with visible quilted edges and scalloped or ribbed perimeter.
4. Warm cream / off-white quilted paper towel texture with absorbent fibrous feel.
5. Visible embossed texture (bumpy square or diamond quilting clearly visible across the napkin face).
6. Skilled-illustrator linework — confident felt-tip pen drawing in the register of a zine cartoonist or comic-book sketch, NOT children's-book kawaii.
7. Thick black felt-tip outlines with dense cross-hatching and parallel-line shading marks for shadow areas (this is the dominant tell of the style).
8. Slightly bleeding marker strokes — ink feathers and bleeds visibly into the absorbent paper around every line.
9. Hand-jittered off-register linework with visible thick/thin variance, occasional double-strokes, no perfect curves.
10. Saturated vivid marker color fills (deep red, brick orange, ochre yellow, cobalt blue, forest green, warm brown) layered inside the black outlines, NOT pastel, NOT watercolor-soft. Color may pool slightly at stroke ends.
11. Limited palette: black-or-dark outline dominant plus 1-3 saturated marker accent colors. Color fills are confident and bold, applied with visible parallel-stroke marker streaking.
12. Hero subject fills 70-80% of the napkin face. The character must have a clear action, expression, prop, or accessory (hat, instrument, food item, tool, thought bubble) — never a blank sitting mascot.
13. Soft diffuse overhead daylight with a subtle shadow beneath the napkin.
14. Cozy spontaneous cafe doodle vibe — feels like a skilled illustrator killed five minutes at a coffee shop, not like a child or AI made it.
15. Light tan coffee/tea stains and age speckles, kept understated and photographic (never decorative).
16. No watermark, no seller signature, no QR codes, no price tags, no marketplace text, no centered logo composition, no clean vector lines, no perfect curves, no photoreal rendering of the doodle itself, no digital-illustration polish, no Adobe Illustrator look, no Pixar 3D rendering, no kawaii/chibi cuteness, no pastel washed-out colors, no flat single-tone fills without marker streaking, no soulless symmetrical character design.

## Variable slots

| Slot | Type | Default | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `{HERO_SUBJECT}` | string, cartoon character / mascot / animal / object | `chubby cartoon cat mascot` | yes | Primary doodle subject. Describe as a quick felt-tip cartoon with expressive simple face, round noodle limbs, small round eyes, optional eyebrows, and any personality props. 1-3 sentences. |
| `{ACCENT_COLOR_1}` | string, optional marker color or fill treatment | `orange marker fill` | no | First non-black marker accent. Simple felt-tip color phrase. Use `none` to skip. |
| `{ACCENT_COLOR_2}` | string, optional marker color or fill treatment | `red marker heart accent` | no | Second non-black marker accent. Omit or keep sparse so the palette stays limited. |
| `{CAPTION}` | string, optional 0-3 handwritten words | `MEOW` | no | Handwritten beneath the doodle in the same marker style. Use `none` to skip. |
| `{NAPKIN_TINT}` | enum: off-white / warm cream / yellowed cream / kraft tan | `warm off-white cream` | no | Base paper color for the quilted napkin or paper towel. |
| `{STAIN_PRESENCE}` | enum/string: none / one coffee ring / tan speckles / scattered crumbs / light tea stains | `one pale coffee ring plus a few tan speckles` | no | Food-service artifacts. Stay subtle and photographic — never decorative. |

## Prompt skeleton

<!-- format: prose-style-deviation -->
<!-- engine: gpt-image-2 via image-gen-cli -->
<!-- size: portrait 1024x1536 PNG (2:3) -->
<!-- quality: high for full generations, low for icon self-test -->

VERTICAL 2:3 PORTRAIT CANVAS, 1024 wide by 1536 tall (taller than wide). Top-down flat-lay photograph of one quilted paper napkin that fills roughly 85% of the vertical frame. The napkin sits on a neutral wood or stone surface that peeks around its scalloped/ribbed edges; a soft shadow sits underneath it. The napkin substrate is {NAPKIN_TINT} paper towel material with a clearly visible bumpy quilted texture (square or diamond embossing pressed across the whole face), absorbent fibers, soft paper wrinkles, and {STAIN_PRESENCE}.

Drawn directly onto the napkin in black felt-tip pen by a skilled zine/comic illustrator killing time at a cafe (NOT a child, NOT a kawaii artist, NOT an AI vector illustration): {HERO_SUBJECT}. The character fills 70-80% of the napkin face and has a clear ACTION, EXPRESSION, OR PROP — never a blank centered mascot. Construct the character in the register of a confident sketchbook cartoon: expressive face with personality, deliberate proportions, hands holding or doing something, accessories or props integrated into the pose.

Linework is the dominant tell of this style:
- Thick black felt-tip outlines, applied confidently in single-stroke gestures.
- Slightly bleeding ink that visibly feathers into the absorbent paper around every line.
- Hand-jittered off-register linework with clear thick/thin variance, occasional double-strokes, and no perfect curves.
- Dense parallel-line shading and cross-hatching in the shadow areas of the figure (under the chin, inside folds, behind props). This hatching is the signature move — do NOT skip it.
- Tight little ink-dot or comma marks for textural detail (fur, stubble, motion lines, sparkles around the figure).

Color is laid down inside the black outlines with saturated vivid felt-tip markers (think: deep red, brick orange, ochre yellow, cobalt blue, forest green, warm brown), NOT pastel and NOT watercolor-soft. Use {ACCENT_COLOR_1} and optional {ACCENT_COLOR_2} as bold marker fills with visible parallel-stroke streaking — the kind of streaking you see when a marker tip drags across paper. Color pools slightly at stroke ends and bleeds gently outside some outlines. Keep the palette to black-dominant plus 1-3 accent colors total.

If {CAPTION} is not "none", write {CAPTION} below the doodle by hand in the same black felt-tip marker, in slightly uneven and off-register block or print letters that look hand-lettered.

Lighting is soft diffuse overhead daylight, even ambient, with a gentle shadow beneath the napkin and subtle paper wrinkles catching highlights. The overall vibe is a cozy spontaneous cafe sketch by a working cartoonist, with {STAIN_PRESENCE} subtle and photographic in the corners.

Hard exclusions (the model's default failure mode is to violate these — do NOT do any of them): no clean vector lines, no perfect curves, no photoreal rendering, no digital-illustration polish, no Adobe Illustrator look, no Pixar 3D rendering, no kawaii or chibi cuteness, no pastel washed-out colors, no flat single-tone color fills without marker streaking, no soulless symmetrical character design, no blank-staring centered mascot, no centered logo composition, no watermark, no QR code, no price tag, no marketplace text, no "@PRINT HAVEN" or any other signature.

## Self-test fill

Used to generate `icon.png` and serve as the regression baseline.

- `{HERO_SUBJECT}` = a grumpy bearded cartoon cat barista in a striped apron, holding a tiny espresso cup in one paw and a steaming milk pitcher in the other, eyebrows furrowed, tongue poking out in concentration, fur drawn with dense black hatching marks for shading on the chest and tail
- `{ACCENT_COLOR_1}` = saturated brick-orange marker fill for the cat's fur patches and apron stripes, with visible parallel-stroke marker streaking
- `{ACCENT_COLOR_2}` = warm brown marker fill for the espresso liquid and a few hatching shadows
- `{CAPTION}` = ONE SHOT
- `{NAPKIN_TINT}` = warm off-white cream
- `{STAIN_PRESENCE}` = one pale coffee ring in the upper-right corner plus a few tan speckles scattered around the edges

# Floating 3D Voxel Toy Renders Template

Source: [Promptbase listing](https://promptbase.com/prompt/floating-3d-voxel-toy-renders) by @promptplazastore (GPT-4O, paywalled). Reconstructed via the reverse-prompt protocol from 9 public previews on 2026-05-17.

## Required invariants (verbatim, reproduce in every prompt)

1. 1:1 square output. Render size 1024×1024 PNG.
2. Pure white #FFFFFF background, no shadow, no gradient, no horizon line.
3. Small centered floating object, ~35-45% of canvas height, perfectly centered.
4. Generous negative space around the subject.
5. Three-quarter product render angle, camera positioned slightly above the subject.
6. Glossy plastic voxel cubes: build the subject from small cubic blocks with visible cube facets.
7. Softly beveled cube edges with rounded corners, visible seams between blocks, no triangulated polygons.
8. Soft upper-left high-key studio lighting with soft specular highlights.
9. No visible cast shadow, no contact shadow, no ground shadow, no ambient occlusion pools.

# Plush 3D Holiday Illustration Template

## Required invariants (verbatim — reproduce in every prompt)

1. **Aspect**: 4:3 horizontal (output 1024×768 unless the user requests otherwise).
2. **Medium**: realistic 3D render baked to a 2D image. Plush, toy-render register — looks like an injection-molded vinyl figurine or stuffed-fabric mascot, not photoreal.
3. **Render engine class**: 3D-baked.
4. **Surface texture**: clean-digital. Background is **perfectly flat — zero gradient, zero noise, zero overlay**. Subject surfaces vary by material: matte fabric / rubberized plastic on most, satin on leather, glossy chrome reserved exclusively for metal hardware.
5. **Process signature**: plush/toy form. Edges softly rounded everywhere except on metal. Sub-surface micro-bump on quilted/ribbed fabric. No photoreal pores, no polygon facets.
6. **Palette** (locked from `palette.md`, hex-bound):
   - `#F7E6D3` soft peach (background — always)
   - `#D81E25` brand red mid · `#F63442` red highlight
   - `#D4860E` mustard mid · `#F79C1D` mustard highlight
   - `#4C86CC` royal blue mid · `#11224C` blue shadow
   - `#DAEFE9` cyan accent
   - `#56C2B8` teal accent
   - `#804513` saddle brown (leather only)
   - `#FAF2D6` sherpa cream (fur-trim, snow)
   - `#E9E9E3` glove off-white
   - `#9B9D96` wheel silver
   - `#231814` line-accent black (use instead of pure `#000000`)
7. **Lighting**: single soft directional key from upper-left at ~60° elevation, wraparound ambient that lifts shadows to mid-tone, one soft elliptical contact shadow under the hero (~10–15% darker than the background, no hard edge).
8. **Form rendering**: present but understated — smooth gradient form-shading on each shape, no painterly brushwork, no rim-light, no aggressive ambient occlusion.
9. **Composition**: single hero, perfect side-profile (zero foreshortening) when the hero is a vehicle/character pair; centered hero with slight rightward drift to balance snowflake scatter; dominant negative space top and bottom-left.
10. **Typography**: integrated only via the branded vehicle wordmark (script + thin sans, white-on-red oval). **No headlines, no captions, no overlay text**. If the user supplies a brand other than Kiehl's, render it inline on the same vehicle/product element only.
11. **Distinctive signatures (Pass C — the "you must include all of the following" block)**:
    - Plush ribbed-coil construction on quilted fabric (puffer jackets, scarves) — 4–6 visible stacked donut rings.
    - If the hero is an animal-anthropomorphic character, give it ONE oversized facial feature (beak, snout, ear-pair) in a contrasting two-tone treatment.
    - At most one visible eye, optionally rendered as a goggle / monocle / single round lens mounted on a helmet or accessory rather than on the face.
    - Sherpa fur-trim repeated in 2–3 places (helmet brow, scarf endpoints, boot/sleeve cuffs).
    - Two white side-stripes on track-pant legs (only when pants are present).
    - Branded product or vehicle as the *only* text-bearing element.
    - 6–8 simple six-armed snowflakes scattered in the negative space, slightly off-white, no shadows on them.
    - Diegetic snow piles on horizontal subject surfaces (fenders, shelves, hat brims, boot tops).
    - Soft elliptical contact shadow only — never a hard cast shadow, never a multi-source shadow.
    - Glossy chrome on metal hardware exclusively; matte everywhere else.
    - No outlines, no captions, no halftone, no paper grain.
12. No watermark, no artist signature, no QR code, no version marker, no platform UI chrome.

## Variable slots

| Slot | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `{HERO_SUBJECT}` | string | "anthropomorphic [animal] character" | required; describe the character or product hero in 1–2 sentences. Animal-anthropomorphic, plush-mascot, or branded product all work. |
| `{HERO_OUTFIT}` | string | "winter outfit with mustard puffer jacket, blue track pants with white side-stripes, sherpa-trim helmet and boots" | required if the hero is a character. Echo the puffer-coil + sherpa-trim invariants verbatim if you want the source feel. |
| `{HERO_VEHICLE_OR_PROP}` | string | "small red cruiser motorcycle with chrome handlebars, brown leather saddlebag, and a rear cargo rack of three wrapped gift boxes (red-striped, teal, yellow-bowed)" | required; the vehicle or product the character interacts with — this is what carries the brand wordmark. |
| `{BRAND_WORDMARK}` | string, ≤24 chars | "Kiehl's SINCE 1851" | optional override; rendered as white script + thin sans on a red oval on the vehicle/product, never anywhere else. Pass empty string `""` to omit the wordmark and ship a brand-free version. |
| `{BACKGROUND_HEX}` | hex string | `#F7E6D3` | optional override; must be flat (no gradient). For winter-cool look, try `#E0EBF1`. For dusk warmth, try `#F4DDC8`. |
| `{SNOWFLAKE_COUNT}` | int 4–10 | 7 | optional override; floating six-armed flakes in negative space. |
| `{ASPECT}` | enum | `4:3` | optional override; the source is 4:3, but `1:1` and `3:2` work with the same composition rules. |

Subject: {HERO_SUBJECT} dressed in {HERO_OUTFIT}, posed in a perfect side-profile riding/holding/operating {HERO_VEHICLE_OR_PROP}. The vehicle/product carries a small "{BRAND_WORDMARK}" wordmark in white script + thin sans on a red oval — this is the only text in the entire image.

Palette is strictly limited to: #F7E6D3 soft peach (background), #D81E25 brand red (with #F63442 highlight), #D4860E mustard (with #F79C1D highlight), #4C86CC royal blue (with #11224C shadow), #DAEFE9 cyan accent, #56C2B8 teal accent, #804513 saddle brown (leather only), #FAF2D6 sherpa cream (fur-trim and snow), #E9E9E3 glove off-white, #9B9D96 wheel silver, #231814 line-accent black. Do NOT use pure black or pure white. Do NOT introduce additional colors.

Composition: single hero, perfect side-profile, centered with a slight rightward drift, generous negative space top and bottom-left. {ASPECT} aspect.

You must include all of the following:
- Plush ribbed-coil construction on any quilted fabric (4–6 stacked donut rings on puffers and scarves)
- If a character: one oversized two-tone facial feature (beak, snout, ear-pair) and at most one visible eye, optionally rendered as a goggle/monocle on a helmet

## Fidelity caveat

This template was derived from **N=1 reference image**. Confidence level: **probable**. Single-source extraction cannot fully constrain a style — future generations may drift from the source aesthetic in ways no single reference could reveal. If the rendered output starts to look generic (3D-render gradient on the background, soft drop shadows on every element, photoreal materials, multiple eyes, outlines re-appearing), return to `references/source-art/source-01.png` and add the failed Pass C signatures back to the prompt explicitly. presets.template:
# Professional Tshirt Design Template

Derived from 9 public preview images on the Promptbase listing `https://promptbase.com/prompt/professional-tshirt-design-generators` by `@celil`. The listing's seller-authored prompt is paywalled; this template is reconstructed via the meta-skill's reverse-prompt protocol against the public previews. See `reverse-prompt-trace.md` for the audit trail.

## Required invariants (verbatim — reproduce in every prompt)

1. 3:4 vertical card. Output 1024x1536 px (or the backend's closest 3:4 resolution).
2. **Naive marker-doodle aesthetic.** The whole image looks brush-pen sketched on paper and screenprinted on a tee. Childlike, playful, slightly sloppy. NOT a polished vector mascot, NOT a refined illustration, NOT 3D-rendered. Reference vibes: hand-drawn streetwear graphic, sticker-art doodle, Keith Haring or Jean Jullien meets screenprint-grunge.
3. One hero subject only. Head and upper body, frontal or 3/4 angle, occupying ~60% of frame height, centered horizontally.
4. Hero wears oversized geometric black-framed sunglasses (rectangular or trapezoidal lenses) with red or yellow tinted glass and 1-2 small white diagonal shine highlights.
5. Hero has a wide toothy white grin with visible rectangular teeth — a goofy mascot expression. Teeth are simple flat white rectangles, not detailed.
6. **Outlines are wobbly and uneven**, drawn with a brush-pen — variable weight, occasional gaps, no clean digital strokes. Anatomy is loose and slightly off-proportion, deliberately childlike.
7. **Interior of the hero is mostly flat solid color** (white, red, yellow). Almost no internal detail. Use only minimal accents: a few black ink scribble marks for fur or texture (3-5 short strokes max), simple round black eye/nose dots, a couple of small black hash marks on cheeks. NO fine shading, NO cross-hatching all over the body, NO gradient, NO detailed fur strands, NO clothing wrinkle lines. Big flat shapes carry the form.
8. Background: solid pitch-black canvas with one or two ragged rectangular color blocks of red `#E63224` and/or yellow `#F5B324` painted behind the subject. Edges are rough, slap-painted, with visible brush strokes and uneven corners — like a printer's color plate misaligned.
9. Floating ornaments around the subject: small white droplets, dots, sparks, three-stroke action burst lines, and a few small abstract red/yellow shards or shapes for energy. No more than ~10 ornaments total. They look hand-drawn, not procedurally placed.
10. Distressed screenprint grunge texture overlay across the whole canvas — fine speckles and ink scratches, subtle, not heavy noise.
11. Single ALL-CAPS one-word `{HEADLINE}` in a **chunky hand-painted brush-cut display sans**, white fill with a heavy black distressed grunge knock-out texture inside the letters. Letters are wide and slightly uneven, like cut paper, not stenciled. Anchored at the top OR bottom of the canvas, ~80-90% of frame width. Letterforms must look hand-drawn, not a system font.
12. Strict 4-color palette only: black `#0A0A0A`, red `#E63224`, yellow `#F5B324`, white `#FFFFFF`. No other hues, no gradients, no halftone color shifts.
13. No watermark, no signature, no QR codes, no price tags, no logo marks, no additional text other than `{HEADLINE}`.
14. Text accuracy: the prompt must quote `{HEADLINE}` verbatim and instruct the model to render that exact string.

## Variable slots

| Slot | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `{HEADLINE}` | string, 1 word, 3-7 chars, ALL CAPS | — | required |
| `{HERO_SUBJECT}` | one cartoon character (animal or stylized human) | — | required |
| `{HEADLINE_ANCHOR}` | enum: `top`, `bottom` | auto: top if 3-4 chars, bottom if 5+ | optional |
| `{PALETTE_BAND}` | enum: `red-dominant`, `yellow-dominant`, `split` | `split` | optional |
| `{LENS_COLOR}` | enum: `red`, `yellow` | matches dominant palette band | optional |

## Prompt skeleton

Compact, concrete-noun structure per `image-prompt-enhancer`. Bullet form scopes attention better than long prose for `gpt_image_2`. Negative clause kept light per the enhancer rule.

```
Hand-drawn marker-doodle screenprint on a black tee. 3:4 portrait.

Subject: {HERO_SUBJECT}, head and shoulders, frontal or 3/4. Drawn with a wobbly black brush-pen outline, variable weight, occasional gaps. Body and face are flat solid color blocks. Oversized chunky black-framed sunglasses, {LENS_COLOR} lenses, two small white diagonal shines. Wide grin showing flat white rectangular teeth.

Detail budget for the character: black ear/eye/nose blobs only, plus 3-5 short black ink scribble strokes for fur or hair direction. No hatching across the body, no fur strands, no shading gradients, no clothing wrinkles.

Background: pitch-black canvas with a {PALETTE_BAND} color block painted behind the subject as a crude ragged rectangle, brush-edged, like a slap-printed color plate.

Around the subject, scatter up to 10 hand-drawn ornaments: small white droplets, white dots, three-stroke burst lines, a couple of small red shards. Subtle screenprint grunge speckle across the whole canvas.

Headline: a single ALL-CAPS word reading exactly "{HEADLINE}", chunky hand-painted brush-cut display sans, wide uneven letters like cut paper, white fill with heavy black grunge knock-out texture inside. Anchor at the {HEADLINE_ANCHOR}, ~85% of frame width.

Palette: only black #0A0A0A, red #E63224, yellow #F5B324, white #FFFFFF.

Avoid: vector polish, 3D rendering, photorealism, halftone, gradients, watermark, signature, extra text, fur strand detail, clothing wrinkle lines.

Aspect 3:4.
```

The skeleton is intentionally short. Leave it short. Each added sentence either adds a concrete noun or a tight constraint — never a vague aesthetic adjective. This is the rule that fixed `v2 → v3`.

## Default fill examples

- Demo: `{HERO_SUBJECT}=cartoon panda head and shoulders wearing a red shirt`, `{HEADLINE}=CHUBY`, `{HEADLINE_ANCHOR}=bottom`, `{PALETTE_BAND}=yellow-dominant`, `{LENS_COLOR}=red`.
- Demo: `{HERO_SUBJECT}=cartoon parrot, head and chest`, `{HEADLINE}=SUMMER`, `{HEADLINE_ANCHOR}=top`, `{PALETTE_BAND}=red-dominant`, `{LENS_COLOR}=yellow`.
- Demo: `{HERO_SUBJECT}=cartoon giraffe head`, `{HEADLINE}=OVER`, `{HEADLINE_ANCHOR}=top`, `{PALETTE_BAND}=red-dominant`, `{LENS_COLOR}=yellow`.

presets.template:
# Rubber Hose Cartoon Icons Template

Reverse-engineered from 9 individual previews + 1 collage on the Promptbase listing "Rubber Hose Cartoon Icons" by @anisgott. Paywalled — every invariant below was derived from the public preview gallery, not from the seller's hidden prompt.

## Required invariants (verbatim — reproduce in every prompt)

1. **Aspect ratio:** 2:3 vertical card. Output size 1024×1536 px.
2. **Hero count:** exactly one main character, full body visible head-to-shoes, centered horizontally, occupying ~70-80% of the canvas height.
3. **Style:** 1920s-1930s American "rubber hose" / "noodle limb" cartoon. Pie-cut eyes (round white sclera with small black pupil and a tiny highlight), classic four-finger white gloves, oversized rounded brown-or-white cartoon shoes, tubular limbs without elbow or knee joints (limbs bend like rubber hose, not like anatomy), oversized round head proportional to a small body (~1:2 head-to-body ratio), bouncy elastic body language. Think Fleischer Studios, early Mickey, Cuphead.
4. **Linework:** uniform-thickness bold black ink outlines on every shape, character and props. No tapered or sketchy lines.
5. **Coloring:** flat cel-shading, one solid color per region, no gradients on character, no airbrush, no glow. Two pink blush dots on cheeks. White highlights on shoes and gloves are flat shapes, not soft gradients.
6. **Background:** a single saturated flat color, no scenery, no gradient, no horizon (unless invariant #9 ground variant is selected). Allowed background hues are listed in `palettes.md`.
7. **Texture:** subtle halftone dot or noise grain over the whole image at low opacity to evoke vintage print, never strong enough to break the flat-color reading.
8. **Accent props (slot, 0-2 items):** small floating objects at corners or near the hands of the character (coin, key, beaker, ghost, tiny sidekick creature, umbrella, ball, trophy, etc.). Outlined and colored in the same style as the hero. Drop entirely if the subject does not need iconography.
9. **Optional ground plane:** if the pose is grounded (running, kicking, standing on a surface), draw a single flat horizontal floor band or shadow patch in the same outlined cartoon style; otherwise the character floats on the flat background with no shadow. Picked per-subject, not always present.
10. **Action accents (optional):** yellow starburst impact lines, motion squiggles, small sweat drops, or wavy mist tendrils may surround the character to telegraph energy. Always rendered with the same uniform black outline.
11. **No text, no headline, no callout copy.** Style is icon-only.
12. **No watermark, no seller signature ("anisgott" or any equivalent), no QR codes, no price tags, no logos.**
13. **No 3D, no realism, no photo, no airbrush, no anime style, no manga, no chibi, no "Pixar".** Hard negative list.

## Variable slots

| Slot | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| {HERO_SUBJECT} | string, full character description (identity, costume, expression, pose) | — | required |
| {BACKGROUND_COLOR} | enum from `palettes.md` | mood-matched to subject | optional override |
| {ACCENT_PROPS} | string list, 0-2 items in cartoon style | none | optional |
| {GROUND_VARIANT} | enum: `floating` \| `flat-floor` \| `shadow-patch` | `floating` | optional |
| {ACTION_ACCENTS} | enum list: `starburst` \| `squiggles` \| `sweat-drops` \| `mist` \| `none` | `none` | optional, max 2 |

Public-figure subjects (real people, copyrighted IP) must be rendered as obvious caricature/parody; users supplying real names should expect cartoon-exaggerated proportions, not likeness reproduction.

## Prompt skeleton

> A 1920s-1930s rubber hose American cartoon icon illustration of {HERO_SUBJECT}.
> Single full-body character centered on a flat saturated {BACKGROUND_COLOR} background, the character occupies about 75% of the canvas height, head-to-shoes visible, vertical 2:3 portrait composition (1024x1536).
>
> Style is strict 1930s rubber hose animation: pie-cut eyes (round white sclera, small black pupil, tiny white highlight), classic white four-finger gloves, oversized rounded cartoon shoes, tubular limbs with no elbow or knee joints, bouncy elastic noodle arms and legs, oversized round head on a small body (head-to-body about 1:2), two pink blush dots on the cheeks. Think Fleischer Studios, early Mickey, Cuphead.
>
> Uniform-thickness bold black ink outlines on every shape, flat cel-shading with one solid color per region, no gradients, no airbrush, no glow, no 3D shading. Subtle halftone dot grain across the whole image at low opacity for a vintage print feel.
>
> {ACCENT_PROPS_BLOCK}  // expands to: "Small floating cartoon props near the character: <prop list>, each rendered with the same black outline and flat colors." OR omitted.
> {GROUND_BLOCK}        // expands to: "The character stands on a flat horizontal floor band drawn in the same outline style." OR "A small flat shadow patch sits under the character's feet." OR omitted (floating).
> {ACTION_BLOCK}        // expands to: "Surround the character with <accent list>: yellow starburst impact lines / curved motion squiggles / small white sweat drops / wavy mist tendrils, all drawn with uniform black outlines." OR omitted.
>
> Hard negatives (do not render): no text, no captions, no headline, no callouts, no watermark, no seller signature, no logos, no QR codes, no price tags, no realism, no photo, no airbrush, no 3D, no anime, no manga, no chibi, no Pixar style, no anatomically correct joints, no soft gradients on the character.
>
> Render at 1024x1536, vertical 2:3, centered hero, saturated single-color background.

## Notes for the agent

- For real-person caricature subjects, prepend to {HERO_SUBJECT}: "an obvious cartoon caricature of <person>, exaggerated rubber-hose proportions, not a likeness reproduction."
- For framed-portrait composition (preview-02 Mona Lisa case), append to {HERO_SUBJECT}: "surrounded by a thick gold ornate baroque picture frame with scrollwork corners."
- For striped patterns (preview-08 Beetlejuice), call them out explicitly: "wearing a black and white vertically striped suit, stripes uniform width."
- For action poses with kicked/thrown objects (preview-09 soccer), name the object in {ACCENT_PROPS} and add a small {ACTION_BLOCK}.
- Mood-to-color mapping (default {BACKGROUND_COLOR}):
  - happy / triumphant → red, orange, or yellow
  - mysterious / spooky → purple or deep green
  - cool / heroic → cobalt blue or teal
  - chaotic / mad-scientist → lime green
- Hero subject occupies ~75% canvas height. If the prop block is large (eagle, sandworm), shrink hero to 65% and place props in upper third.

# Vintage Retro Computer Screen Terminal Template

> Fidelity is locked. Enhancement is a separate, explicit request after acceptance.

## Unanimous structural invariants

1. A square, straight-on CRT monitor fills the frame, with a thick rounded charcoal-black bezel and softly vignetted convex screen. (9/9 previews)
2. The screen is a near-black forest-green field carrying only luminous green phosphor marks and text. (9/9 previews)
3. The hero and interface are constructed in coarse, evenly gridded lime-green dot-matrix pixels rather than smooth raster art. (9/9 previews)
4. Boot-sequence terminal typography, prompt markers, rule dividers, and a large lower title establish the screen hierarchy. (9/9 previews)

## Discriminative signatures

### The central subject is a recognizable monochrome line-and-dot portrait or emblem, assembled with conspicuous ASCII-era halftone stippling rather than filled illustration.
- Evidence: preview-01.png, preview-02.png, preview-03.png, preview-04.png, preview-05.png, preview-06.png, preview-07.png, preview-08.png, preview-09.png (9/9 previews)
- Discriminative weight: 5/5
- Prompt clause: render the subject as a recognizable monochrome line-and-dot portrait or emblem assembled with conspicuous ASCII-era halftone stippling rather than filled illustration
- Medium/process/substrate: green phosphor CRT display · coarse dot-matrix rasterization and ASCII-terminal drawing · curved low-resolution CRT glass
- Irregularity: purposeful
- Composition exception: The hero can be a centered portrait, two smaller figures, or a left/right split, but must remain inside the CRT screen and be built from the same dot grid.

### The image uses restricted monochrome green with a slight phosphor halo and granular uneven dot density, avoiding clean vector edges and multicolor neon.
- Evidence: preview-01.png, preview-02.png, preview-03.png, preview-04.png, preview-05.png, preview-06.png, preview-07.png, preview-08.png, preview-09.png (9/9 previews)
- Discriminative weight: 5/5
- Prompt clause: keep a restricted monochrome green palette with a slight phosphor halo and granular uneven dot density; avoid clean vector edges and multicolor neon
- Medium/process/substrate: single-color phosphor emission · luminous pixel bloom over dark cathode-ray display · slightly noisy dark CRT glass
- Irregularity: purposeful
- Composition exception: The precise green intensity can vary from pale terminal text to brighter hero dots, but no additional hue is allowed.

### Dense terminal status lines and dotted rules form a practical boot-display frame around the hero, especially in the more technical examples.
- Evidence: preview-02.png, preview-04.png, preview-06.png, preview-08.png, preview-09.png (5/9 previews)
- Discriminative weight: 4/5
- Prompt clause: frame the hero with dense terminal status lines, dotted rules, and a plausible boot-display layout
- Medium/process/substrate: monospace terminal display · boot-sequence interface composition · CRT screen typography
- Irregularity: not marked purposeful
- Composition exception: For deliberately sparse source-like layouts, retain a minimum of a command prompt and one top-line boot message instead of a full status block.

## Variable slots

| Slot | Type | Required | Default | Notes |

presets.template:
# Cinematic Product Ad Poster Template

Source: `Cinematic Product Ad Poster Generators` by @litlestaxr (Promptbase #3028, GPT-Image-2). Triangulated from 9 public previews on 2026-05-01.

## Required invariants (verbatim — reproduce in every prompt)

1. **Aspect** — 2:3 portrait. Output 1024×1536.
2. **Hero** — exactly one packaged consumer product (e.g., aluminum can, glass jar, plastic bottle, paper pint, plastic cup) centered, tilted 5–15° on its vertical axis, floating mid-frame. Subject occupies 50–60% of frame height.
3. **On-pack typography** — render the product's brand wordmark and one flavor sub-label legibly on the package itself. No external floating headline, no caption, no callouts, no QR code, no price tag, no watermark, no seller signature.
4. **Background** — single dominant flavor-matched color band with a subtle vignette gradient. Pick the band from `palettes.md`. Background must read as a clean studio backdrop, not a literal scene.
5. **Effect layer** — exactly one of `liquid_ribbon`, `lightning`, `wings`, `splash`, `claw_rays`, `flame_burst`, `sparkle_orbit` from `palettes.md`, wrapping or radiating from the hero product.
6. **Orbiting flavor accents** — 3–8 ingredient or flavor elements from the matching accent bank in `palettes.md`, distributed around the hero in negative space, partially overlapping the frame edges.
7. **Atmospheric particles** — at least sparkles, plus one matching band particle (bubbles / droplets / crumbs / dust). Particles fill the field at low density, never crowding the hero.
8. **Lighting** — cinematic 3-point: key from upper-left or upper-right, soft fill, rim/edge glow tracing the silhouette of the product. Drop-shadow or soft glow halo directly under the floating product to anchor it.
9. **Render style** — hyperrealistic 3D commercial product render. Crisp focus on the hero, slight depth-of-field on accents, no painterly brushwork.
10. **Negation** — no human hands, no faces, no body parts, no other products in frame, no logos other than the product's own brand, no extra text.

## Variable slots

| Slot | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `{PRODUCT_NAME}` | string | — | required. Verbatim brand wordmark to render on-pack. |
| `{PRODUCT_TYPE}` | enum: aluminum can, slim can, glass jar, plastic bottle, paper pint, plastic cup, pouch, glass bottle | aluminum can | required. |
| `{FLAVOR_LABEL}` | string, 1–3 words UPPERCASE | "" (omit if not given) | optional sub-text on-pack. |
| `{BACKGROUND_BAND}` | enum from palettes.md backgrounds | inferred from flavor | required. |
| `{EFFECT_LAYER}` | enum from palettes.md effects | `liquid_ribbon` | required. |
| `{FLAVOR_ACCENTS}` | comma-separated list of 3–8 items from accent bank | inferred from band | required. |
| `{PARTICLE_LAYER}` | enum: bubbles, droplets, crumbs, dust, plus implicit sparkles | inferred from band | required. |

If the user gives only the product name, infer `{BACKGROUND_BAND}`, `{EFFECT_LAYER}`, `{FLAVOR_ACCENTS}`, `{PARTICLE_LAYER}` from the product's flavor category using `palettes.md` triggers. Surface the inferred picks before generating.

## Prompt skeleton

This is the literal prose passed to gpt_image_2. Substitute the slots verbatim, do not paraphrase.

```
Cinematic hyperrealistic product advertising poster, 2:3 vertical portrait composition.

Hero: a single {PRODUCT_TYPE} of {PRODUCT_NAME}, centered, floating mid-frame, tilted 8 degrees on its vertical axis. The package's brand wordmark "{PRODUCT_NAME}" is rendered crisply on the front of the pack. {FLAVOR_LABEL_LINE}. The product occupies roughly 55% of the frame height. No human hands, no faces, no other products.

Background: a clean studio backdrop in the {BACKGROUND_BAND} color band with a soft circular vignette darkening toward the corners. No scene props, no floor lines, no horizon, just a graded color field.

Effect layer: a dynamic {EFFECT_LAYER} effect wraps and radiates from the hero, suggesting motion and energy. Render the effect with believable physics — glossy highlights on liquid, electric arcing on lightning, soft feathered edges on wings.

Orbiting accents: {FLAVOR_ACCENTS} float around the hero in dynamic 3D positions, at varying depths, some partially clipped by the frame edge. They look freshly cut or freshly poured, lit consistently with the hero.

Atmospheric layer: subtle {PARTICLE_LAYER} and small white sparkle highlights drift through the field at low density. Lens-flare-style starbursts on the brightest highlights.

Lighting: cinematic 3-point lighting, key light from upper-left, soft fill, strong rim glow tracing the silhouette of the package. A soft glow halo under the floating product anchors it to the frame.

Style: hyperrealistic 3D commercial product render, sharp focus on the hero, gentle depth of field on the accent layer, crisp specular highlights, no painterly brushwork.

Strictly do not render: external headline text, captions, callouts, QR codes, price tags, watermarks, seller signatures, multiple products, human body parts, or any logo other than the {PRODUCT_NAME} brand wordmark on the package itself.
```

`{FLAVOR_LABEL_LINE}` substitution rule:
- If `{FLAVOR_LABEL}` is non-empty: `Below the wordmark a smaller all-caps sub-label reads "{FLAVOR_LABEL}".`
- If empty: `No additional flavor sub-label below the wordmark.`

## Generation parameters

- backend: Higgsfield (primary) or built-in `image_gen` (fallback)
- model: `gpt_image_2`
- quality: `high` (mandatory — mid-tier breaks ribbon physics and on-pack text)
- aspect: `2:3`
- size hint: `1024x1536`

Log `backend=... model=gpt_image_2 quality=high aspect=2:3` in the response that produces the image.

presets.template:
# Creative Director Ad Concepts — Template

Source: Promptbase listing "Creative Director Ad Concepts" by @promptplazastore. Reconstructed from 9 public preview images (paywalled prompt). The aesthetic is Cannes Lions / D&AD poster work — one surreal photoreal metaphor + one short bold headline. The image *is* the punchline; the headline names the abstraction.

## Required invariants (verbatim — reproduce in every prompt)

1. **Aspect ratio:** 2:3 portrait. Output 1024×1536 px (default), or any 2:3 multiple the backend allows.
2. **Hero count:** exactly **one** surreal photoreal metaphor. One impossible object, creature, scene, or composite. No second focal subject, no group, no crowd, no inset frame.
3. **Hero placement:** hero subject occupies the upper 60-75% of the canvas. Lower 25-30% is a visual quiet zone reserved for typography. Hero may extend into the quiet zone for compositional reasons but the bottom 15% must remain readable.
4. **Headline rendering:** verbatim copy from the `{HEADLINE}` slot, rendered as **bold uppercase sans-serif, white, centered, 1-3 lines, 2-4 words total** by default. Use `{HEADLINE_STYLE}` only when the user explicitly switches to `serif-italic` (fashion register) or `left-aligned` (streaming/cinema register).
5. **Background:** atmospheric, cinematic, single coherent environment that the metaphor inhabits. No clutter, no extra characters, no real-world signage, no graphic backdrops. May be a pure void (black, sand, fog) when the metaphor calls for product-photography precision.
6. **Lighting:** one dominant light source — either a key light from a specific direction, an overhead halo, or self-illumination from the hero. Deep shadows, vignetted corners, shallow depth-of-field feel. Cinematic.
7. **Palette:** a tightly bound 3-4 color band tied to `{PALETTE_MOOD}`. No more than four working colors per frame. White type sits above the palette.
8. **No watermarks, no seller signature, no QR codes, no price tags, no real licensed logos.** Brand mark slot `{BRAND_MARK}` is optional and used only when the user supplies one; otherwise omit entirely.
9. **Photoreal-cinematic register.** Treat as advertising photography, not illustration. Surfaces have material weight: skin, paper crinkle, water refraction, smoke turbulence, metallic plinth. No painted-over flat shading.
10. **Text accuracy:** quote `{HEADLINE}` verbatim in the prompt. The model must render exactly those characters, exactly that case, exactly that punctuation. Quote `{SUB_TAGLINE}` and `{BRAND_MARK}` verbatim if provided.

## Variable slots

| Slot | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `{HEADLINE}` | string, 2-4 words | — | required. Imperative, paradox, or short declarative. Punctuation allowed. |
| `{HERO_METAPHOR}` | string, 1-2 sentences | — | required. The surreal central image, described concretely. |
| `{PALETTE_MOOD}` | string label or 3-4 hex/color names | — | required. Pick a tight band; do not list more than four colors. |
| `{LIGHTING}` | string | "single dominant key light, deep shadows, vignetted corners" | optional override |
| `{ENVIRONMENT}` | string | derived from metaphor | the wider scene the hero occupies |
| `{HEADLINE_STYLE}` | enum: `bold-uppercase-sans-centered` (default) / `serif-italic-centered` / `bold-uppercase-sans-left-aligned` | `bold-uppercase-sans-centered` | optional |
| `{SUB_TAGLINE}` | string, 3-8 words, all caps | empty | optional. Renders thin spaced caps under the headline. |
| `{BRAND_MARK}` | string or short logo description | empty | optional. Tiny mark below the type stack; otherwise omit. |

## Prompt format selected

**JSON spec with embedded layout directive for typography.** Per `gpt-image-2-techniques`, JSON spec wins on hyperreal advertising photography (lighting + materials), and the typography zone needs a layout-as-prompt clause to nail the verbatim headline.

## Prompt skeleton (engine input)

The engine input is a JSON block describing the scene, followed by a short layout-as-prompt directive for the headline. Both are sent as one prompt.

```text
Award-winning conceptual advertising poster in the style of Cannes Lions / D&AD finalists. 2:3 portrait, photoreal cinematic. Render exactly the spec below.

{
  "format": {
    "aspect_ratio": "2:3 portrait",
    "output_size_px": [1024, 1536],
    "register": "advertising photography, not illustration",
    "rendering": "photoreal, hyper-detailed surfaces, shallow depth of field, vignetted corners, cinematic"
  },
  "subject": {
    "metaphor": "{HERO_METAPHOR}",
    "count": 1,
    "placement": "occupies upper 60-75% of frame, centered horizontally",
    "material_truth": "every surface (skin, smoke, water, fabric, food, metal, glass) is rendered with believable physical detail; no flat shading"
  },
  "scene": {
    "environment": "{ENVIRONMENT}",
    "background_rule": "single coherent atmospheric field; no extra characters, no signage, no clutter, no other focal points",
    "lighting": "{LIGHTING}",
    "atmosphere": "soft volumetric haze where appropriate; otherwise crisp"
  },
  "palette": {
    "mood": "{PALETTE_MOOD}",
    "max_working_colors": 4,
    "type_color": "white"
  },
  "negation": [
    "no watermark",
    "no QR code",
    "no price tag",
    "no Promptbase or seller signature",
    "no licensed real-world logo unless explicitly listed in brand_mark",
    "no second focal subject",
    "no inset frames or split-screen overlays unless the metaphor itself is a split"
  ],
  "brand_mark": "{BRAND_MARK}"
}

Typography (layout-as-prompt):
- Anchor a typographic block in the bottom 25% of the canvas, centered horizontally.
- Render exactly this headline, in white, in bold uppercase sans-serif: "{HEADLINE}".
- Style override: {HEADLINE_STYLE}. If the override is "serif-italic-centered", render in white serif italic title case instead. If "bold-uppercase-sans-left-aligned", left-anchor the block at the lower-left third with three lines max.
- If sub-tagline is provided, render exactly: "{SUB_TAGLINE}" in thin spaced caps, ~30% the size of the headline, on a single line beneath the headline.
- If brand mark is provided, render exactly: "{BRAND_MARK}" as a small mark or wordmark below the type stack, ~15% the size of the headline.
- The headline must read crisply and not overlap the hero subject.
```

## Worked example (canonical demo)

For the self-test icon, fill the skeleton with:

- `{HEADLINE}` = `"DRINK THE LIGHT"`
- `{HERO_METAPHOR}` = `"a clear glass bottle that contains a captured sunset — golden clouds, miniature mountains, and a low-flying flock of birds suspended inside the glass; condensation beading on the outside; the bottle floating in mid-air with no hand holding it"`
- `{PALETTE_MOOD}` = `"deep navy void, molten gold, soft amber bottle highlights"`
- `{LIGHTING}` = `"sunset light radiating outward from inside the bottle as the dominant key, void-black ambient fill, subtle rim on the glass shoulders"`
- `{ENVIRONMENT}` = `"floating in a dark navy void; faint dust particles catching the bottle's glow"`
- `{HEADLINE_STYLE}` = `"bold-uppercase-sans-centered"`
- `{SUB_TAGLINE}` = empty
- `{BRAND_MARK}` = empty

This subject exercises every invariant: single hero, surreal-photoreal metaphor, atmospheric void, single dominant light source, tight palette band, headline in default style, no decorations.

# Dynamic Low-Angle Brand Ad Posters Template

## Required invariants (verbatim — reproduce in every prompt)

presets.template:
# Emergency Glass Box Ad Template

Source: Promptbase listing "Emergency Glass Box Creative Ads" by @farhan, GPT-Image-2 (paywalled, 9-preview corpus, 2026-05-05). Triangulated visually — see `reverse-prompt-trace.md`.

## Required invariants (verbatim — reproduce in every prompt)

1. **Aspect ratio.** 1:1 square. Output size 1024×1024 (or 2048×2048 for full quality runs). The cabinet is the hero; do not crop it tighter than ~70% of frame area.
2. **Background.** Solid vivid fire-engine red wall with soft ambient red glow. No texture, no noise, no gradient banding. The cabinet casts a faint shadow on the wall.
3. **Cabinet.** Glossy red metal emergency-break-glass cabinet, centered, slightly larger than tall (or perfectly square). Visible four bolts at the four corners of the metal frame. Transparent glass front with a subtle white-highlight reflection band along the top edge. A small red interior ledge holds the product.
4. **Hammer on chain.** A red emergency-break safety hammer hanging on a steel chain from the right side of the cabinet, slightly outside the frame, partially overlapping the wall. Always on the right, never on the left.
5. **Headline inside the box.** White uppercase condensed bold sans-serif. Three lines, top-of-box centered: smaller `"IN CASE OF"` → larger `{EMERGENCY_REASON}` (the largest type in the composition, may wrap to 2 lines) → medium `"BREAK GLASS"` rendered per `{BREAK_GLASS_TREATMENT}`.
6. **Hero product.** Single photoreal commercial product photo. Centered inside the glass box, sitting on the inner red ledge. Product alone — no hands, no models, no extra props inside the cabinet.
7. **Brand block below cabinet.** Centered, white type. Order: optional `{BRAND_GLYPH}` → `{TAGLINE_PRIMARY}` → optional `{TAGLINE_SECONDARY}` → `{BRAND_NAME}` wordmark. The brand block sits in the bottom ~15% of the frame; the cabinet is the visual hero, the block is supporting copy.
8. **Lighting.** Soft frontal-top key light on the cabinet. Strong ambient red bounce. Slight specular hits on the glass front and the metal frame.
9. **No watermark, no seller signature, no QR codes, no price tags, no website URLs.** No "@farhan", no Promptbase artifacts, no stock-photo overlays.
10. **Text accuracy.** Render `{EMERGENCY_REASON}`, `"IN CASE OF"`, `"BREAK GLASS"`, `{TAGLINE_PRIMARY}`, `{TAGLINE_SECONDARY}`, and `{BRAND_NAME}` verbatim with no extra letters, no auto-correction, no misspellings. If a tagline contains punctuation or italics, preserve it.

## Variable slots

| Slot | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `{EMERGENCY_REASON}` | string, 1-3 short words, ALL CAPS | — | required. Mood: a relatable urgent need the product solves. Examples: `MONDAY`, `STRESS`, `BAD DAY`, `COLD WEATHER`, `BOREDOM`, `DRY SKIN`, `DATE NIGHT`, `HUNGER`, `DEAD BATTERY` |
| `{HERO_PRODUCT}` | string (photoreal product description) or image ref | — | required. One item only. Describe shape, material, label/wordmark, and color. |
| `{BRAND_NAME}` | string, 1-3 words | — | required. Renders as a wordmark below the cabinet. |
| `{TAGLINE_PRIMARY}` | string, ≤8 words, uppercase or sentence case | — | required. The marketing line directly above the brand. |
| `{TAGLINE_SECONDARY}` | string, ≤8 words | empty | optional. Use when `TAGLINE_PRIMARY` reads better as a setup-then-payoff. |
| `{BRAND_GLYPH}` | enum: `none` \| `heart` \| `droplet` \| `lightning` \| `mountain` \| `controller` \| `flame` \| custom one-line description | `none` | optional. Small white icon between primary and secondary tagline (or between primary tagline and brand wordmark). |
| `{BREAK_GLASS_TREATMENT}` | enum: `flat-white` \| `dash-flanked` \| `white-pill` \| `dark-pill` \| `red-pill` | `flat-white` | controls how `BREAK GLASS` renders inside the box. |
| `{EMERGENCY_REASON_DECOR}` | enum: `none` \| `flank-dashes` \| `flank-chevrons` | `none` | optional ornamentation around the emergency-reason word. |

## Prompt skeleton

> Square 1:1 commercial product advertising poster, photoreal. A glossy fire-engine-red metal emergency-break-glass cabinet, centered, occupying about 70% of frame area, mounted on a vivid red wall with soft ambient red glow. The cabinet has a transparent glass front with a subtle white reflection band along the top edge, four metal bolts at the four corners of the frame, and a small red interior ledge inside it. Hanging on a steel chain off the right side of the cabinet is a red emergency-break safety hammer, partly outside the cabinet against the wall.
>
> Inside the glass box, top-center, white uppercase condensed bold sans-serif text: "IN CASE OF" (smaller, single line) above "{EMERGENCY_REASON}" (largest line, condensed bold; render exactly{EMERGENCY_REASON_DECOR_NOTE}), and below it "BREAK GLASS" rendered as {BREAK_GLASS_TREATMENT_NOTE}. All text is white unless the treatment specifies otherwise. Spell every word exactly.
>
> Centered on the red interior ledge inside the box: {HERO_PRODUCT}. Single product only, photoreal commercial product photography, no hands, no people, no extra props inside the cabinet.
>
> Below the cabinet, in the bottom 15% of the frame, centered white type: {BRAND_GLYPH_NOTE} "{TAGLINE_PRIMARY}"{TAGLINE_SECONDARY_NOTE}, then a clean "{BRAND_NAME}" wordmark.
>
> Lighting: soft frontal-top key light on the cabinet, strong ambient red bounce on the wall and inside the box, faint specular hits on the glass front and the metal frame, slight cabinet shadow on the wall.
>
> No watermark, no QR code, no price tag, no website URL, no seller signature, no stock-photo overlay. Render every quoted string verbatim.

### Substitution table for the `_NOTE` placeholders

When you assemble the final prompt, replace these inline notes with the rendered phrasing matching the user's slot choice:

- `{EMERGENCY_REASON_DECOR_NOTE}` →
  - `none` → empty string
  - `flank-dashes` → `, with short white horizontal dashes flanking the line on both sides`
  - `flank-chevrons` → `, with small white chevrons flanking the line on both sides`
- `{BREAK_GLASS_TREATMENT_NOTE}` →
  - `flat-white` → `flat white uppercase sans-serif text`
  - `dash-flanked` → `flat white uppercase sans-serif text with short horizontal white dashes flanking it on both sides`
  - `white-pill` → `white uppercase sans-serif text inside a white rounded pill-shaped button with red text on white background`
  - `dark-pill` → `white uppercase sans-serif text inside a dark/near-black rounded pill-shaped button`
  - `red-pill` → `white uppercase sans-serif text inside a saturated red rounded pill-shaped button`
- `{BRAND_GLYPH_NOTE}` → if `none`, empty; else `a small white {BRAND_GLYPH} icon glyph above the tagline,`
- `{TAGLINE_SECONDARY_NOTE}` → if non-empty, `, then on a new line "{TAGLINE_SECONDARY}"`; else empty

The skeleton plus the substitution table is the engine input. Do not ask the model to "design" the layout — every visual decision is fixed in the invariant block.

## Negative prompt (apply to every generation)

`No second product, no humans, no hands, no logos other than the brand name, no watermark, no QR code, no price tag, no shopping URL, no Promptbase signature, no `@farhan` text, no shelf, no store interior, no fluorescent overhead light, no blue or green wall, no transparent or PNG background.`

presets.template:
# Futuristic Product Ad Template

Derived from the 9 previews of Promptbase listing "Futuristic Product Ad Templates" by @nomii. Triangulation confidence: high (9 previews, single coherent visual system).

## Required invariants (verbatim — reproduce in every prompt)

1. 1:1 square frame. Output size 1024×1024.
2. ONE hero subject — product OR lifestyle person — centered, occupying ~55-70% of the frame, lower-mid placement.
3. ONE headline at the top in pure white, ultra-bold condensed display sans-serif (Helvetica Bold Condensed / Inter Black / Bebas Neue style — heavy weight, tight letterspacing). Verbatim copy slot {HEADLINE}. Single English word, 3-7 letters typical.
4. The headline is partially overlapped or crossed by the hero subject or by its surrounding glow/splash effect. Never fully clean. The occlusion is the signature of the style — it sells depth.
5. A mood-matched neon / glow / splash / smoke / spark / light-streak effect surrounds the hero. Slot {EFFECT_TYPE}. Slot {GLOW_COLOR} is a single dominant neon tint matched to the brand mood.
6. Dark mood-matched background. Slot {BACKGROUND_TINT}. Solid or radial gradient by default; a dim cinematic interior is allowed when the headline is a lifestyle word.
7. Cinematic studio lighting: strong top/rim light on the hero, deep falloff into the background, shallow depth of field on the hero.
8. Hyperreal photographic rendering — no illustration, no 3D-render look, no painterly stylization.
9. NO callouts, NO badges, NO QR codes, NO price tags, NO logos, NO captions, NO watermarks, NO seller signature.
10. Text accuracy — quote {HEADLINE} verbatim in the prompt and demand crisp legible letterforms.

## Variable slots

| Slot | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| {HEADLINE} | string, 1 word, 3-7 letters | required | All caps preferred for max impact; title case allowed |
| {HERO_SUBJECT} | string (product OR person + pose) | required | Be specific: material, color, action, framing |
| {GLOW_COLOR} | string | mood-matched | e.g., "warm caramel brown", "electric cyan blue", "fiery red-orange", "magenta and violet", "rainbow pigment", "lime green", "golden amber", "spark orange" |
| {EFFECT_TYPE} | enum | mood-matched | splash, swirl, lightning halo, smoke plume, ember sparks, dust explosion, neon ring, light streaks |
| {BACKGROUND_TINT} | string | dark + tonal cousin of glow | default to a near-black tinted with the glow hue |
| {CASE} | "ALL_CAPS" \| "Title" | ALL_CAPS | Title case is acceptable for short softer words like "Stay" or "Bite" |

## Prompt skeleton

> Hyperreal cinematic product advertisement. **1:1 square format, 1024×1024.** A single hero subject — **{HERO_SUBJECT}** — sits centered in the lower-middle of the frame, occupying roughly 60% of the canvas, photographed with a strong top-and-rim light, shallow depth of field, deep tonal falloff into a dark **{BACKGROUND_TINT}** background. Surrounding the hero is a dramatic **{GLOW_COLOR} {EFFECT_TYPE}** that radiates outward and rises into the upper portion of the frame. Across the top of the canvas, a single **{CASE}** word — **"{HEADLINE}"** — is rendered in pure white, ultra-bold condensed display sans-serif (Helvetica Bold Condensed / Bebas Neue style), tight letterspacing, large enough to span most of the frame width. The hero subject and/or its glow effect must visibly cross over and partially occlude the lower edge of the headline letters — this overlap is mandatory and sells depth. Hyperreal photographic rendering, magazine-quality cinematic lighting, no illustration, no 3D-render aesthetic. **Absolutely no other text, no callouts, no badges, no QR codes, no price tags, no logos, no captions, no watermarks, no seller signature anywhere in the image.** The only text in the image is the single word "{HEADLINE}".

## Failure-mode negations to keep in the prompt

- "no other text" — gpt-image-2 likes to add taglines.
- "no logo" — it adds invented brand marks otherwise.
- "no price tag, no QR" — common bleed-through from product-photo training data.
- "single word only" — multi-word headlines drift into multi-row layouts that break the style.
- "the headline is partially occluded by the hero" — without this it always renders the headline cleanly above the hero with a gap, killing the depth signature.
