presets.template:
# Isometric Pixel Art Animations Template

Refined version: outputs an **8-12 keyframe sprite sheet** so each generation yields a fluid loop when sliced and played back at 8-12 fps. The source Promptbase listing only previewed 3 keyframes; this skill extends the same visual language into a full animation cycle.

## Required invariants (verbatim — reproduce in every prompt)

1. **Sprite-sheet canvas.** Output a single PNG sprite sheet. Default size 1024×1024 for grid layouts, or 1792×1024 (16:9) for single-row strips of 6-8 frames. Pure white or fully transparent background, no border.
2. **Frame count between 8 and 12.** The triptych is replaced by a longer animation loop. Pick `{FRAME_COUNT}` ∈ {8, 9, 10, 12} based on the {ANIMATION_TYPE}; never fewer than 8, never more than 12.
3. **Even, regular grid layout.** Frames are laid out on a uniform grid with equal cell width and height. Allowed layouts:
   - 8 frames → **4×2** grid (4 columns, 2 rows)
   - 9 frames → **3×3** grid
   - 10 frames → **5×2** grid
   - 12 frames → **4×3** grid (default, best balance for chunky pixel readability)
   - 6-8 frames horizontal strip → 1 row, allowed only on 16:9 or 21:9 aspect
   Reading order is **left-to-right, top-to-bottom** (Western reading order). Each cell holds exactly one sprite of the same {SUBJECT}, no overlap, no shared shadow between cells.
4. **One subject across all frames.** Every cell shows the same {SUBJECT} at a different keyframe of the same {ANIMATION_TYPE} cycle. No mixed subjects, no perspective change between cells.
5. **16-bit pixel art rendering.** Chunky low-resolution pixel grid, hard pixel edges, no anti-aliasing on hero silhouettes, no smooth gradients. Visible pixel-stair on every curve. Each sprite cell renders at roughly 96-256 pixels of effective resolution before scaling.
6. **Three-quarter isometric perspective.** Hero shown from a slightly elevated three-quarter angle so volume reads. Frontal flat sprites are not acceptable. The same camera angle applies to every cell.
7. **Bold dark outline.** Each sprite carries a 1-pixel near-black or hue-shifted-dark outline against the cell background.
8. **Limited palette per subject.** 4-6 colors plus outline; saturated mid-tones, no neon, no soft pastel washes. Match the {PALETTE_BAND} category.
9. **Per-cell soft pixel drop shadow.** Below each sprite, a small dotted/dithered shadow puddle inside its own cell. No shared ground plane across cells.
10. **Animation cue layer.** Particle / FX (fire, steam, motion-arc, embers, dust, glow) appears on the action frames only — never on frame 1. For an N-frame cycle, FX typically begins at frame ⌈N/3⌉ and peaks around frame ⌈2N/3⌉ before tapering.
11. **Loopable cycle.** Frame 1 = rest / start state. Frame N = end state that visually returns to frame 1 with no visible jump. Mid-action frames must interpolate smoothly so a game engine can play frames 1→N→1→N at 8-12 fps without stutter.
12. **Cell separation.** Equal margin between cells. **Optional thin grid:** if `{GRID_LINES}` = `true`, a 1-pixel light-grey grid separates cells; default `false` (cells separated by white space only).
13. **No text, no headlines, no callouts, no UI chrome, no QR codes, no seller signature, no Promptbase watermark, no frame number, no labels.**
14. **Transparent-friendly composition.** Each sprite sits on white or alpha; designed for direct slice + drop into a game scene without background removal.
15. **Slice-ready geometry.** Cell dimensions are integer-divisible into the canvas (e.g., 1024÷4=256). The user can slice with `imagemagick` or `pillow` using cell width/height = canvas_width÷cols / canvas_height÷rows.

## Variable slots

| Slot | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| {SUBJECT} | string, 1-4 words | — | required, e.g. "wooden treasure chest", "cream pixel rabbit", "iron cauldron" |
| {ANIMATION_TYPE} | string, 1-3 words | — | required, e.g. "opening", "hopping", "boiling", "growing", "swinging sword", "walking cycle" |
| {FRAME_COUNT} | int 8-12 | 12 | required; auto-pick based on cycle complexity (8 for short toggles, 12 for full character cycles) |
| {GRID_LAYOUT} | enum | derived from FRAME_COUNT | 8→4×2, 9→3×3, 10→5×2, 12→4×3 |
| {KEYFRAMES} | list of N short clauses | auto-decompose | required if user supplies; otherwise the model interpolates between rest → mid → peak → return |
| {PALETTE_BAND} | enum from palettes.md | category-default | optional |
| {FX_LAYER} | string or `none` | none | particle, motion arc, steam, embers, glow |
| {GRID_LINES} | bool | false | thin separator lines between cells |
| {CANVAS_ASPECT} | enum | 1:1 (1024×1024) | use 16:9 only when frame count ≤ 8 and a single horizontal strip is preferred |

## Keyframe auto-decomposition (when user does not supply explicit keyframes)

For a 12-frame cycle, default decomposition:

1. Frame 1 — full rest / closed / cold / pre-action
2. Frame 2 — first hint of motion (1/12 in)
3. Frame 3 — building / windup / opening crack
4. Frame 4 — early action
5. Frame 5 — half-action
6. Frame 6 — mid-action / mid-swing / lid clearly ajar
7. Frame 7 — past-mid action
8. Frame 8 — approaching peak
9. Frame 9 — peak / fully open / full-flame / peak compression
10. Frame 10 — settle / first ease-out
11. Frame 11 — ease-out / smoke trail / coast
12. Frame 12 — return-to-rest (loops to Frame 1)

For 8-frame cycles, drop frames 2, 4, 8, 11 from the table. For 9-frame, drop frames 2, 5, 8. For 10-frame, drop frames 2, 11.

## Prompt skeleton

> A 16-bit isometric pixel art **sprite sheet** on a pure white background, {CANVAS_ASPECT} canvas. Render exactly {FRAME_COUNT} sprites of the same {SUBJECT} arranged in a uniform {GRID_LAYOUT} grid (left-to-right, top-to-bottom reading order). Each cell shows the same {SUBJECT} at a different keyframe of one fluid {ANIMATION_TYPE} animation cycle: {KEYFRAMES}. The cycle is loopable — frame {FRAME_COUNT} returns visually to frame 1 with no jump. Render in chunky 16-bit pixel art with hard pixel edges, no anti-aliasing on hero silhouettes, no smooth gradients, visible pixel-stair on every curve. All cells use the same three-quarter isometric perspective and the same camera angle. Limited {PALETTE_BAND} palette of 4-6 mid-tone saturated colors plus a 1-pixel near-black outline around every sprite. Each cell holds a small dithered soft-pixel drop shadow puddle under its sprite, no shared ground plane. {FX_LAYER} appears only on the action frames (begins around frame ⌈{FRAME_COUNT}/3⌉, peaks around ⌈2·{FRAME_COUNT}/3⌉), never on frame 1 and never on frame {FRAME_COUNT}. Cells are equally spaced with no overlap, separated by white space only ({GRID_LINES}=false), and each cell is integer-divisible into the canvas so the sheet slices cleanly into individual sprites. No headline, no text, no callouts, no UI, no QR codes, no watermark, no signature, no border, no frame number, no labels. Background is pure white, designed for direct game-engine slice + drop-in. Classic retro RPG / strategy / simulator pixel-art game asset style.

## Negation block (append when GPT-Image-2 drifts)

> Negative: blurry sprites, anti-aliased edges, photoreal rendering, soft gradient shading, motion blur lines spanning multiple cells, fewer than 8 sprites, more than 12 sprites, sprites overlapping cell boundaries, sprites of different sizes between cells, mixed subjects, frame numbers, written labels, color background, perspective grid, watermark, brand logo, single shared ground plane stretching across cells.

## Slicing the output

Once generated, the user can slice into N individual frame PNGs:

```bash
# 4×3 grid at 1024×1024 → 256×256 sprites
magick icon.png -crop 256x256 +adjoin frame-%02d.png
# Then play back at 10 fps in the game engine.
```

Frame timing recommendation for game engines: **8-12 fps** for chunky pixel art; the eye expects to see each frame, the staircase aesthetic is part of the charm.

presets.template:
# Sprite Sheet Animation Pack Template

Reproduces the Promptbase listing **"Sprite Sheet Animation Packs"** by `@acb` (model tag: ChatGPT Image). Source previews under `source-previews/`. Updated 2026-05-03 after first self-test failed on WALK/RUN/JUMP/DEATH/HIT-REACTION rows; refinements informed by `@givros` sprite-sheet pattern (X 2026-04-30, 110 likes, 121 bookmarks).

## Required invariants (verbatim — reproduce in every prompt)

1. **1:1 aspect ratio**, output 1024×1024 (or source-matched 800×800). Pure flat black background, no border, no frame, no checkerboard, no transparency grid.
2. **Exactly 7 horizontal animation rows**, stacked top to bottom in this fixed order, with each row label rendered verbatim:
   1. `IDLE`
   2. `WALK CYCLE`
   3. `RUN`
   4. `ATTACK COMBO`
   5. `JUMP ARC`
   6. `DEATH`
   7. `HIT REACTION`
3. **Row labels** rendered as white uppercase bold condensed sans-serif (Helvetica Bold / Arial Black look), right-aligned inside a narrow ~10%-canvas-width left margin column. Vertically centered to each row's character baseline. **No other text anywhere on the canvas.**
4. **Per-row frame counts are exact, not approximate.** Use these counts:
   - IDLE: **4** frames
   - WALK CYCLE: **5** frames
   - RUN: **5** frames
   - ATTACK COMBO: **5** frames
   - JUMP ARC: **5** frames
   - DEATH: **5** frames
   - HIT REACTION: **4** frames
5. **Frames in each row are visibly distinct from their neighbors.** No two adjacent frames may be identical or near-identical poses. Each frame advances the animation forward in time.
6. **Uniform cell width per row.** All frames in a row share the same horizontal slot width. Frames are evenly distributed left-to-right inside the canvas's right ~90% column. No grid lines, no cell borders, no row separators — only implied negative space.
7. **Consistent baseline per row.** Every character's feet (or prone collapse plane in DEATH) align to the same horizontal line within the row.
8. **Identity lock across all 7 rows.** Same character, same proportions, same wardrobe, same prop in every frame. The character's head silhouette, palette, and prop must be 100% identical frame-to-frame; only the pose changes.
9. **Orientation lock — character faces right (profile view) by default.** Exceptions: DEATH frames 4–5 may rotate to prone; JUMP ARC frame 3 (apex) may angle slightly upward; HIT REACTION frame 1 may twist back from impact. All other frames are right-facing profile.
10. **HD pixel-art game-sprite rendering style.** Crisp 1-pixel outlines, limited cel shading (≤16 colors per character), readable silhouette at 1/4 scale. NOT 3D render. NOT painterly. NOT photo-real. NOT low-res chunky 8-bit. Modern HD pixel-art look, like 2D fighting-game roster art or premium indie-game promo sheets.
11. **Lighting & atmosphere keyed to `{COLOR_PALETTE}`.** Soft rim glow, slight bloom on glow elements, ground shadow implied beneath each pose. No global studio lighting.
12. **`{PARTICLE_TYPE}` particles** (embers / sparkles / dust / muzzle-flash / `none`) appear only on action frames — primarily ATTACK COMBO, HIT REACTION, DEATH. Particles may break individual cell width inside a row but never bleed between rows.
13. **Hard exclusions:** no watermark, no logo, no PromptBase tag, no price tag, no QR code, no signature, no decorative border, no checkerboard transparency background, no row dividers, no extra text other than the seven row labels.

## Variable slots

| Slot | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `{HERO_SUBJECT}` | string, prose description | — | Required. Describe character/creature with enough detail for identity lock (silhouette, materials, proportions). |
| `{HERO_PROP}` | string | — | Required. Primary weapon or tool — drives ATTACK COMBO row geometry. Examples: "energy blade", "fire axe", "rifle", "claws", "bow", "blaster". |
| `{COLOR_PALETTE}` | string, 3-color band | — | Required. Dominant trio. Examples: "magenta and cyan with white highlights", "crimson, molten orange, charcoal grey". |
| `{PARTICLE_TYPE}` | enum | `none` | Optional. One of `embers`, `sparkles`, `dust`, `muzzle-flash`, `none`. |
| `{ATTACK_TYPE}` | enum | `melee` | Optional. `melee` (5-stage swing arc), `ranged` (draw-aim-fire-recoil-recover), `punch` (chamber-extend-impact-retract-recover). Controls ATTACK COMBO row layout. |

## Prompt skeleton

> Generate a 1:1 sprite-sheet animation poster on a pure flat black background, 1024×1024.
>
> SUBJECT (identity-locked, identical in every frame):
> {HERO_SUBJECT} carrying {HERO_PROP}.
> Color palette: {COLOR_PALETTE}.
>
> RENDERING STYLE:
> - HD pixel art, 2D game sprite style.
> - Crisp 1-pixel outlines, ≤16-color cel shading per character.
> - Readable silhouette at small scale.
> - Soft rim glow keyed to the palette; slight bloom on glow elements.
> - Implied ground shadow beneath each pose. No global studio lighting.
> - {PARTICLE_TYPE} particles only on action frames (ATTACK COMBO, HIT REACTION, DEATH).
>
> LAYOUT:
> - 7 horizontal animation rows, stacked top to bottom.
> - Leftmost ~10% of the canvas is a narrow margin column holding the row label, right-aligned, in white uppercase bold condensed sans-serif (Helvetica Bold / Arial Black look). The label is the ONLY text on its row.
> - Right ~90% of the canvas holds the row's frames, evenly distributed left-to-right with uniform cell width per row.
> - All frames in a row share the same baseline (feet aligned to the same horizontal line).
> - No cell borders. No grid lines. No row dividers. Pure flat black between frames and between rows.
> - The character faces right (profile view) in every frame by default. Only DEATH frames 4–5 may rotate to prone, JUMP ARC frame 3 may angle slightly upward, HIT REACTION frame 1 may twist back from impact.
>
> ROWS — each row labeled verbatim, frame counts exact, every frame visibly distinct:
>
> Row 1 — label "IDLE" — 4 frames:
>   Frame 1: neutral standing pose, weight centered, {HERO_PROP} held loose.
>   Frame 2: subtle inhale, chest lifts ~5%, head level.
>   Frame 3: subtle exhale, chest settles, slight head dip.
>   Frame 4: return to neutral, weight shifts a hair to back foot.
>
> Row 2 — label "WALK CYCLE" — 5 frames:
>   Frame 1: contact pose, front heel strike, back foot toe push, arms swing in opposition.
>   Frame 2: down pose, front knee bends to absorb weight, hips drop.
>   Frame 3: passing pose, back leg swings forward through center, hips at midline.
>   Frame 4: up pose, push-off rises, hips lifted, opposite leg now front.
>   Frame 5: contact pose mirrored, opposite foot strikes, opposite arm swing.
>   Walk pacing — slow, grounded, both feet near ground throughout the cycle.
>
> Row 3 — label "RUN" — 5 frames:
>   Frame 1: contact pose, deep forward lean, front foot strikes hard.
>   Frame 2: airborne push-off, back leg fully extended behind, body angled forward.
>   Frame 3: full-flight apex, BOTH feet off the ground, opposite knee high in front.
>   Frame 4: airborne descent, leading foot reaching forward to land.
>   Frame 5: contact mirrored, hard heel strike, body still leaning forward.
>   Run pacing — fast, aggressive, body tilted ~15° forward; clearly distinct from WALK CYCLE by the mid-air apex frame and forward lean.
>
> Row 4 — label "ATTACK COMBO" — 5 frames using {ATTACK_TYPE}:
>   For melee: F1 wind-up (weapon back, weight loaded on rear foot), F2 mid-swing (arc through horizontal), F3 contact frame (weapon at peak extension, faint motion trail), F4 follow-through (weapon past body, weight forward), F5 recovery (weapon lowered, ready stance).
>   For ranged: F1 draw/raise weapon, F2 aim (weapon level, eye-line down sights), F3 fire (muzzle-flash or arrow loose, body absorbing recoil), F4 post-shot (recoil settling, weapon slightly raised), F5 recovery (weapon lowered, ready stance).
>   For punch: F1 chamber (fist back, body coiled), F2 step in, F3 impact (fist fully extended, faint shockwave at knuckles), F4 retract (arm pulling back), F5 recovery (ready stance).
>
> Row 5 — label "JUMP ARC" — 5 frames:
>   Frame 1: crouch loaded, knees deeply bent, arms back for momentum.
>   Frame 2: lift-off, legs extending, arms swinging forward and up.
>   Frame 3: apex, legs tucked under body, body horizontal or slightly tilted upward, max height.
>   Frame 4: descent, legs dropping toward ground, arms forward for balance.
>   Frame 5: landing, knees absorbing impact, weight low, prepared to stand.
>   The 5 frames must read as a clear vertical arc — frame 3 is visibly the highest off the baseline.
>
> Row 6 — label "DEATH" — 5 frames:
>   Frame 1: hit registers, body recoils backward, arms flung outward.
>   Frame 2: stagger, off-balance, leaning back, knees buckling.
>   Frame 3: collapse, knees give way, body falling backward at ~45°.
>   Frame 4: prone landing, body horizontal on the ground, {HERO_PROP} dropped or beside.
>   Frame 5: final still, body fully prone, optional fade or ember/dust scatter ({PARTICLE_TYPE} appropriate).
>   The 5 frames must read as a clear collapse sequence from upright to prone.
>
> Row 7 — label "HIT REACTION" — 4 frames:
>   Frame 1: impact, body twists back from the hit, head jerks, {PARTICLE_TYPE} spark/ember at the hit point.
>   Frame 2: recoil peak, body fully twisted, off-balance, opposite foot lifted.
>   Frame 3: stabilize, body un-twisting, returning toward neutral, weight resettling.
>   Frame 4: recovery, back to ready stance, alert and unhurt-but-responding.
>
> ANTI-DUPLICATE RULE: every frame in every row must be visibly different from its immediate neighbors. No two adjacent frames may share the same pose, the same limb angles, or the same weapon position. If you would emit a duplicate, advance the animation to the next stage.
>
> HARD EXCLUSIONS: no watermark, no logo, no PromptBase tag, no price tag, no QR code, no signature, no caption, no decorative border, no checkerboard transparency, no row dividers, no extra text — only the seven row labels listed above.

presets.template:
# Nintendo 64 Cover Art Template

## Required invariants (verbatim, reproduce in every prompt)

1. 3:2 landscape game-box cover layout. Output size 1024x768 PNG.
2. Late-1990s Nintendo 64 cover-art format.
3. Full-bleed late-1990s airbrushed cover art covering the main art field.
4. Subtle printed-box scuff and grid texture across the full canvas.
5. Top logo bar spanning the full top edge.
6. Top-right diagonal "Only For N" badge folded into the top-right corner.
7. Nintendo 64 wordmark and multicolor cube logo rendered in the top logo bar.
8. Right-edge vertical platform logo bar with red/orange/yellow color stripes.
9. Side ESRB strip in the lower right corner.
10. Nintendo Seal of Quality (gold oval) lower left with "Made in Japan" microcopy nearby.
11. Publisher mark rendered as a small white block in the right rail.
12. Large stacked lower title block with huge beveled 3D arcade letters, heavy drop shadow, warm gradient fills.
13. Centered oversized hero illustration overlapping the scene and the title naturally.
14. White line-art accessory icons in the right rail.
15. High-contrast arcade typography.
16. No watermark, no QR code, no price tag, no modern UI.
17. Every rendered string ("NINTENDO 64", {GAME_TITLE}, {PUBLISHER_NAME}, {GENRE_LABEL}, {ESRB_RATING}, "Made in Japan", "Official Nintendo Seal of Quality", "Only For", feature callouts) must appear verbatim at its declared anchor.

## Variable slots

| Slot | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| {HERO_SUBJECT} | string or image ref | yes | Large expressive hero artwork; include pose, costume, and one foreground action prop. |
| {GAME_TITLE} | string, 1-5 words | yes | Rendered exactly in the title block; include 64 when the concept needs an N64-era title. |
| {PUBLISHER_NAME} | string, 1-2 words | yes | Small publisher mark in the right rail or footer. |
| {GENRE_LABEL} | string, 1-3 words | yes | Short side-rail retail category, e.g. Action / Adventure. |
| {ESRB_RATING} | enum-like string | yes | Rendered as rating caption and letter, e.g. EVERYONE / E / ESRB. |
| {PALETTE_MOOD} | string palette descriptor | yes | Drives title gradient, side stripes, lighting, and background color mood. |
| {BACKGROUND_SCENE} | string, 1 sentence | yes | Scene behind the hero with era-appropriate props and atmospheric depth. |
| {FEATURE_CALLOUTS} | string, 2 short callouts | yes | Right-rail feature copy such as "Designed for N64 Controller Pak / 1 Player". |

## Prompt skeleton

<!-- format: layout-as-prompt -->

Required invariants: '3:2 landscape game-box cover layout'; 'late-1990s Nintendo 64 cover-art format'; 'full-bleed late-1990s airbrushed cover art'; 'subtle printed-box scuff/grid texture'; 'top logo bar'; 'top-right diagonal Only For N badge'; 'Nintendo 64 wordmark and cube logo'; 'right-edge vertical platform logo bar'; 'side ESRB strip'; 'Nintendo Seal of Quality'; 'publisher mark'; 'large stacked lower title block'; 'centered oversized hero illustration'; 'white line-art accessory icons'; 'high-contrast arcade typography'. Create a fictional late-1990s Nintendo 64 retail box cover for gpt-image-2 at quality=high. Use a 1024x768 landscape artboard coordinate map while preserving the 3:2 N64 cover composition. Main art field: x=0 y=0 w=848 h=768, full-bleed {BACKGROUND_SCENE}, saturated glossy 3D/cel-painted mascot rendering, scuffed printed cardboard texture, fold/grid wear, color mood {PALETTE_MOOD}. Place {HERO_SUBJECT} as the large centered oversized hero illustration, dynamic perspective, overlapping the scene and title naturally. Top logo bar: x=0 y=0 w=1024 h=88; render 'NINTENDO 64' with the multicolor N cube and late-1990s platform branding. Top-right diagonal Only For N badge: x=838 y=0 w=186 h=132; folded yellow/cream or white/orange corner wedge, render 'ONLY FOR' plus red handwritten 'Only For' and a small red arrow. Right-edge vertical platform logo bar: x=848 y=0 w=176 h=768; red/orange/yellow side color stripes, white line-art accessory icons, and {FEATURE_CALLOUTS}. Title block: x=56 y=438 w=760 h=250; render {GAME_TITLE} exactly in huge stacked beveled 3D arcade letters with thick outlines, heavy drop shadow, warm gradient fills, and integrated trailing 64 treatment when present. Publisher mark: x=868 y=540 w=136 h=46; render {PUBLISHER_NAME} as a small white publisher mark. Genre label: x=868 y=492 w=136 h=34; render {GENRE_LABEL} as compact side-rail copy. Nintendo Seal of Quality corner: x=40 y=642 w=150 h=88; render a gold oval reading 'Official Nintendo Seal of Quality' plus tiny 'Made in Japan' microcopy nearby. ESRB corner / side ESRB strip: x=866 y=620 w=138 h=128; render {ESRB_RATING} as a black-and-white ESRB-style block with large rating letter, 'CONTENT RATED BY', and 'ESRB'. Keep all rendered text inside these anchors. No watermark, no QR code, no price tag, no modern UI.

## How to fill the skeleton

1. Replace every `{SLOT}` with the user's value. Slot text must appear inside the skeleton's single quotes for verbatim rendering on canvas.
2. Do not paraphrase any invariant phrase. Do not move anchor coordinates. Do not add new rendered text.
3. Pass the resulting block as a single `--prompt` argument to image-gen-cli with `--quality high --size "landscape 1024x768 PNG"`.

# Nirvana Nevermind Parody Template

## Required invariants (verbatim — reproduce in every prompt)

1. Square 1:1 album-cover framing. Output size 1024×1024.
2. Nirvana Nevermind compositional reference.
3. Single underwater hero.
4. Underwater POV with visible rippled surface.
5. Eyes-open swimmer reaching toward bait.
6. Bait suspended from a thin line descending from above.
7. Lighting from rippled water surface above.
8. Bubbles and suspended particle layer.
9. Depth gradient in lower half.
10. Photoreal underwater photography register.
11. Full-bleed cover art with no border.
12. No literal text.

## Variable slots

| Slot | Type | Default | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| {SWIMMER_SUBJECT} | string | — | yes | Named character, mascot, creature, or parody subject swimming underwater; preserve recognizable silhouette, proportions, expression, and iconic accessories. |
| {BAIT_OBJECT} | string | — | yes | Tempting object dangling from a thin line or hook above and to the right of the swimmer. |
| {WATER_PALETTE} | string | — | yes | Underwater color palette and mood, including surface tint and deeper lower-frame fade. |
| {POSE_NOTE} | string | "" | no | Optional subject-specific orientation or reach detail; must keep the single swimmer reaching toward upper-right bait. |

## Prompt skeleton

<!-- format: prose -->

```
Square underwater photograph in the visual language of Nirvana's 1991 'Nevermind' album cover: a single {SWIMMER_SUBJECT} floats as the single underwater hero in square 1:1 album-cover framing, a Nirvana Nevermind compositional reference with underwater POV with visible rippled surface. Show an eyes-open swimmer reaching toward bait near the upper right, with {POSE_NOTE} only if supplied. Place {BAIT_OBJECT} as bait suspended from a thin line descending from above, just out of reach. Use {WATER_PALETTE} with lighting from rippled water surface above, bubbles and suspended particle layer, depth gradient in lower half, full-bleed cover art with no border, and a photoreal underwater photography register; the subject may retain its native illustrated, cartoon, mascot, or 3D identity but must be optically integrated into the water. Identity-lock {SWIMMER_SUBJECT}: preserve the swimmer's silhouette, proportions, expression, and any iconic accessories specific to {SWIMMER_SUBJECT}. Keep no literal text anywhere in the artwork. No text, no logos, no watermark, no puzzle pattern, no Promptbase grid, no signature, no price tag, no QR code.
```

## Negative directives (always include verbatim)

The tail clause `No text, no logos, no watermark, no puzzle pattern, no Promptbase grid, no signature, no price tag, no QR code.` is non-negotiable. It exists to override the watermark prior the source previews carry (the puzzle-piece overlay on every Promptbase preview).

presets.template:
# Simpsons Mega Style Template

## Required invariants (verbatim — reproduce in every prompt)

1. dominant vertical 2:3 poster composition
2. clean 2D animated sitcom cel look
3. thick black cartoon outlines
4. flat saturated color fills
5. simple cel shading with minimal texture
6. crisp vector-like edge quality
7. bright high-contrast palette
8. simplified geometric perspective backgrounds
9. rounded clouds, bushes, buildings, and props
10. yellow cartoon skin when people appear
11. large round white eyes with dot pupils when faces appear
12. exaggerated rounded noses and overbite mouths
13. four-finger cartoon hands when visible
14. clear comic pose or expression
15. foreground subject or prop separated from background
16. optional rounded headline or environmental signage
17. no marketplace watermark, QR code, or seller mark
18. no extremist, fascist, Soviet, or real-political insignia; no armbands or dictator likenesses

## Variable slots

| Slot | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| {STYLE_VARIANT} | enum: character scene | cameo portrait | background plate | fantasy crossover | photo-to-cartoon poster | character scene | Controls which source subgroup grammar to emphasize while preserving the same cel-cartoon visual contract. |
| {SOURCE_REFERENCE_PHOTO} | optional image ref or empty string | — | Use only when the user wants a photo-to-cartoon conversion; preserve broad likeness, outfit, pose, and pet markings without photorealism. |
| {SUBJECT} | string, subject/person/pet/group/object/background anchor | — | Primary user-controlled subject. For a background plate, describe the empty room, storefront, park, or focal object. |
| {CHARACTER_COUNT} | integer or short phrase | 1 | Supports zero characters for background plates, one character, pairs, family/group scenes, or character plus pet. |

# Bright Product Benefit Infographic Template

## Required invariants (verbatim — reproduce in every prompt)

1. **2:3 vertical card.** Output size 1024×1536 px. No other aspect.
2. **One hero, centered.** A single photorealistic studio-rendered product occupies ~50-60% of frame height, vertically centered, with a soft ambient light and a subtle ground shadow. No second product, no human hands.
3. **Solid saturated single-hue background.** No gradient, no pattern, no scenery, no texture. The hue comes from the slot {BACKGROUND}.
4. **Top-center headline.** Bold sans-serif (Inter / Manrope / Poppins family), white, the product name verbatim from {HEADLINE}, rendered in case-style {HEADLINE_CASE} (`ALLCAPS` or `Title Case`). Two-line wrap allowed for 3-4 word headlines.
5. **{CALLOUT_COUNT} callouts arranged symmetrically.** Anchor presets:
   - 4: top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right
   - 5: 4 corners + bottom-center
   - 6: 3 stacked left (top-shoulder / mid / base) + 3 stacked right (same)
6. **Each callout = thin-line white vector icon + 1-3 word white sans-serif label.** Icon sits above label. Icon style is single-stroke outline, no fill, ~32-48px equivalent weight. Label is uppercase OR title case to match {HEADLINE_CASE}.
7. **Optional bracket connectors.** Thin curved white lines arc from each callout label toward the hero silhouette. Default: ON. Skip when {CONNECTOR_BRACKETS} = false.
8. **No watermark, no QR code, no price tag, no third-party logo, no seller signature.**
9. **No additional text.** Only the headline and the callout labels carry text. Body text on the product is allowed only if the {HERO_SUBJECT} naturally carries a printed label and {HERO_BODY_TEXT} is provided explicitly.
10. **Text accuracy contract.** Quote {HEADLINE} and every callout label verbatim in the prompt and instruct the model to render them character-for-character. Keep callouts to 1-3 simple words to reduce text-rendering glitches.

## Variable slots

| Slot | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| {HEADLINE} | string, 1-4 words | — | required, product name |
| {HEADLINE_CASE} | enum: `ALLCAPS` \| `Title Case` | `ALLCAPS` | optional override |
| {HERO_SUBJECT} | prose description, 1-3 sentences | — | required; describe materials, color, framing |
| {BACKGROUND} | enum from `palettes.md` | `sunny yellow` | optional override |
| {CALLOUT_COUNT} | enum: 4 \| 5 \| 6 | 5 | optional override |
| {CALLOUT_1..N} | string, 1-3 words | — | required, benefit phrase per anchor |
| {CALLOUT_ICON_N} | string, icon glyph hint | inferred from label | optional, e.g., `lightning`, `leaf`, `shield-check` |
| {CONNECTOR_BRACKETS} | bool | `true` | optional |
| {HERO_BODY_TEXT} | string | — | optional; only when product naturally carries a printed label |

## Prompt skeleton

> Vertical 2:3 product infographic, 1024×1536 px. Saturated solid {BACKGROUND} background, no gradient, no pattern, no scenery.
>
> Centered hero, photoreal studio render, soft ambient light, subtle ground shadow: {HERO_SUBJECT}. The hero occupies about 55% of frame height, vertically centered.
>
> Top-center headline reads {HEADLINE_CASE}: "{HEADLINE}". Bold geometric sans-serif (Inter / Manrope), white, large. Two-line wrap allowed for headlines longer than two words.
>
> {CALLOUT_COUNT} callouts arranged around the hero. Each callout is a thin single-stroke white outlined vector icon stacked above a 1-3 word white sans-serif label. Anchors and verbatim labels:
> - {ANCHOR_1}: icon = {CALLOUT_ICON_1}, label = "{CALLOUT_1}"
> - {ANCHOR_2}: icon = {CALLOUT_ICON_2}, label = "{CALLOUT_2}"
> - {ANCHOR_3}: icon = {CALLOUT_ICON_3}, label = "{CALLOUT_3}"
> - {ANCHOR_4}: icon = {CALLOUT_ICON_4}, label = "{CALLOUT_4}"
> - (… up to {CALLOUT_COUNT})
>
> {IF CONNECTOR_BRACKETS} Add thin curved white lines arcing from each callout toward the hero silhouette. {ENDIF}
>
> Render every text element character-for-character with no spelling mistakes. Use the exact strings provided. Do not invent additional text.
>
> Negative space rule: clean solid background with no patterns. No watermark, no QR code, no price tag, no third-party logo, no seller signature.

## Anchor coordinates (for self-test verification)

In a 1024×1536 frame:

| Anchor | x % | y % |
|---|---|---|
| top-left | 18 | 22 |
| top-right | 82 | 22 |
| mid-left | 14 | 50 |
| mid-right | 86 | 50 |
| bottom-left | 18 | 78 |
| bottom-right | 82 | 78 |
| bottom-center | 50 | 88 |

Use these as eyeball checks during the icon self-test, not as hard pixel targets — gpt-image-2 places callouts within ±5%.

presets.template:
# Premium Product Ads Template

Derived from the Promptbase listing **"Premium Product Ads"** by **@abdelrhmanfikri** (paywalled). Reconstruction is reverse-engineered from 9 public preview images, not the seller's hidden prompt.

## Required invariants (verbatim — reproduce in every prompt)

1. **2:3 vertical portrait card.** Output size `1024x1536`. Never landscape, never square.
2. **One hero product** on a plinth, marble block, floating shelf, or wall-and-floor corner. Hero is centered horizontally, sits in the lower 50–60% of the canvas, and is rendered at a slight 3/4 angle so depth and material are readable.
3. **Top text block** anchored to the upper third of the canvas. Two lines:
   - Line 1: `{BRAND_NAME}` — 1–2 words, display-weight headline, 100–110 px optical size.
   - Line 2: `{PRODUCT_CATEGORY}` — 1–3 words, tracked-out subhead, ~40% of headline size.
4. **Bottom signature line** anchored to the lower 8% of the canvas, centered: `{STUDIO_SIGNATURE}` — 1–2 words, all caps, sub-headline weight. Drop only if explicitly disabled by the user.
5. **Brand mark printed on the product itself** must read `{BRAND_NAME}` (or its short form). Embossed on a charging case, debossed on a leather panel, dial print on a watch, label on a bottle — match the substrate. This is the ad-authenticity tell. Never substitute a generic logo.
6. **Mood band locked** to one entry from `palettes.md`. Background, light direction, plinth material, and accent color all derive from the chosen band.
7. **Lighting** is single-source studio: directional soft key plus subtle rim. Warm bands cast a botanical leaf shadow on the back wall; cool bands cast a clean rim or a neon line across one edge.
8. **Negative space dominates.** No props, no clutter, no QR codes, no prices, no review stars, no UGC photo grain. The card reads as a luxury print ad, not a marketplace listing.
9. **Typography rule by band:**
   - Tech / utility / wellness-clinical bands → bold geometric sans (Inter Bold / Helvetica Now Display Bold) all caps.
   - Luxury / beauty / fragrance bands → elegant high-contrast serif (Bodoni / Didone-class) for `{BRAND_NAME}`, light sans for `{PRODUCT_CATEGORY}` and `{STUDIO_SIGNATURE}`.
10. **Text accuracy.** Quote `{BRAND_NAME}`, `{PRODUCT_CATEGORY}`, and `{STUDIO_SIGNATURE}` verbatim in the prompt and tell the model to render them exactly. No spelling drift, no extra words, no "lorem" placeholders.
11. **No watermark, no seller signature, no Promptbase tag, no @abdelrhmanfikri text artifact.**

## Variable slots

| Slot | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `{BRAND_NAME}` | string, 1–2 words | — | required. Invented luxury brand. ALL CAPS in render. |
| `{PRODUCT_CATEGORY}` | string, 1–3 words | — | required. ALL CAPS in render. |
| `{STUDIO_SIGNATURE}` | string, 1–2 words | `{BRAND_NAME} STUDIO` | optional. Drop on user opt-out. |
| `{PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION}` | string | — | required. Concrete physical description: form factor, materials, finish, colorway, branded mark. |
| `{MOOD_BAND}` | enum from `palettes.md` | `tech-dark` | controls background, plinth, lighting, accent, type family. |
| `{TYPE_FAMILY}` | enum: `bold-sans` \| `elegant-serif` | derived from `{MOOD_BAND}` | override only when user explicitly asks. |

## Prompt skeleton

Single-block prose prompt for `gpt_image_2` at `quality=high`, aspect `2:3` (1024x1536). Substitute slots before sending.

```
Premium product advertisement card, 2:3 vertical portrait, magazine print quality.

Hero subject: {PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION}. The product carries the brand mark "{BRAND_NAME}" rendered directly on its surface in a way native to its material (embossed, debossed, label, dial print, etched, or screen-printed). Product sits at a slight three-quarter angle on a {PLINTH_FROM_BAND}, occupying the lower 55% of the frame, centered horizontally.

Background and palette: {BACKGROUND_FROM_BAND}. Mood: {MOOD_DESCRIPTION_FROM_BAND}.

Lighting: {LIGHTING_FROM_BAND}. Soft directional key from upper-{KEY_DIR_FROM_BAND}, subtle rim, no harsh speculars on the headline area.

Typography (render the text exactly as written, no substitutions, no extra words):
- Top headline, centered in the upper third: "{BRAND_NAME}" set in {TYPE_FAMILY_PRIMARY}, ALL CAPS, color {HEADLINE_COLOR_FROM_BAND}, letter-spacing tight.
- Sub-headline directly under the headline: "{PRODUCT_CATEGORY}" in {TYPE_FAMILY_SECONDARY}, ALL CAPS, ~40% the size of the headline, color {HEADLINE_COLOR_FROM_BAND}, tracked out.
- Bottom signature, centered in the lower 8%: "{STUDIO_SIGNATURE}" in {TYPE_FAMILY_SECONDARY}, ALL CAPS, ~35% the size of the headline, color {HEADLINE_COLOR_FROM_BAND}.

Composition rules: large negative space, single product, no human figures, no props, no UGC clutter, no second product. The product brand label must match the headline text exactly. Spell every word correctly. Do not invent additional copy. Do not draw a watermark, QR code, price tag, review stars, social handle, or Promptbase mark.

Render: photographic, sharp focus on the product, shallow depth of field on the background, fine surface micro-detail (carbon weave, leather grain, frosted glass, brushed metal as appropriate), studio cleanliness.
```

## Engineering notes

- `gpt_image_2` reliably renders short ALL-CAPS English headlines; keep `{BRAND_NAME}` ≤ 9 letters and `{PRODUCT_CATEGORY}` ≤ 18 characters total to avoid line-break drift.
- If text drifts after a generation, re-run with the failed copy quoted verbatim a second time at the end of the prompt — the model treats repetition as priority weight.
- The brand-on-product label is the highest-failure invariant. If it disappears, escalate via reverse-prompt protocol Step 2 (identity-lock modifier) — append `the printed/embossed mark on the product must read exactly "{BRAND_NAME}", legible, no misspellings`.
- Never let the model add a person, hand, or face. Append `no people, no hands, no faces` if it slips in lifestyle-style props.

# Product Ad Poster With QR Mockup — Template

Reconstructed from the Promptbase listing "Product Ad Posters With Qr Mockups" by @kalekaboom (paywalled). Triangulated from 5 public previews.

## Required invariants (verbatim — reproduce in every prompt)

1. **Aspect** — vertical 3:4 portrait poster (gpt_image_2 native; nearest match to the source's √2:1 ISO-paper proportion). Output 1024×1536 px.
2. **Two-zone composition** — dominant left/center hero zone (≈ 65% of canvas width) + narrow right info column (≈ 35% of canvas width). Strict separation: no callouts cross the seam except the headline if explicitly placed at top-right (luxury variant).
3. **Headline** — bold sans-serif uppercase headline {HEADLINE} broken into 2-4 short stacked lines, last word rendered in {ACCENT_COLOR}, ending with a period. Top-left placement by default; top-right only when {VARIANT} = "luxury".
4. **Sub-headline** — three-power-word small-caps tagline {SUB_HEADLINE} with periods between words, set immediately under the headline at lighter weight and tracked letter spacing.
5. **Body paragraph** — 2-4 short prose lines {BODY_PARA} describing the product, set under the sub-headline at body weight.
6. **Hero product photograph** — single hero subject {HERO_PRODUCT} centered in the dominant zone, shallow depth of field, soft directional studio key light + atmospheric environmental backdrop {HERO_ENVIRONMENT} that matches the brand mood (waves/ice for tech, swirling liquid for beauty, gym/concrete for fitness, gold-leaf/velvet for luxury, warm wood/beans for food). No floor shadows that conflict with the paper edge.
7. **Right info column — top line** — small monoline glyph + one-line "experience" caption {EXPERIENCE_LINE}, optional but recommended.
8. **Right info column — QR panel** — a rounded-rectangle panel filled with the {ACCENT_COLOR} containing a clean scannable QR code (the QR pattern itself can be a generic placeholder; do not encode any real URL) + a CTA headline {CTA_HEADLINE} formatted "SCAN TO [VERB] [BENEFIT]." or "TAP TO [VERB] [BENEFIT]" + an optional sub-line {CTA_SUBLINE}. Panel anchors at the upper-middle of the right column.
9. **Right info column — three feature blurbs** — exactly 3 stacked feature blurbs in the lower right column. Each blurb has a monoline icon, a bold {ACCENT_COLOR} feature name {FEATURE_N_NAME}, and a one-line description {FEATURE_N_LINE}. Never 2, never 4. The visual rhythm of three blurbs is part of the contract.
10. **Brand wordmark — bottom-left** — large brand wordmark {BRAND_NAME} + smaller tagline {BRAND_TAGLINE_LEFT}.
11. **Brand wordmark — bottom-right** — small brand wordmark + URL or hashtag {BRAND_URL_OR_HASHTAG}.
12. **Palette** — cohesive 2-3 color band: one dark or neutral background tone + one or two {ACCENT_COLOR} hues drawn from the product's brand mood. Never more than three dominant hues.
13. **Type system** — heavy bold uppercase sans for headline (e.g., Inter Black / Helvetica Bold / Neue Haas Grotesk), light/regular sans for body, tracked uppercase for CTA and feature names. Use a subtle serif italic only when {VARIANT} = "luxury".
14. **Photography** — premium product-advertising aesthetic. Soft directional key light, gentle rim, environmental backdrop in the brand palette, sub-millimeter sharp focus on hero, atmospheric haze allowed.
15. **Negative space** — at least 8% top margin and 8% bottom margin around the canvas; do not let the hero or text bleed off the edges.
16. **No watermarks** — no "DO NOT COPY" or any seller signature, no price tags, no extra QR codes, no logos other than {BRAND_NAME}, no captions outside the slots above.
17. **Text accuracy** — every text slot (HEADLINE, SUB_HEADLINE, CTA_HEADLINE, FEATURE_N_NAME, FEATURE_N_LINE, BRAND_NAME, BRAND_TAGLINE_LEFT, BRAND_URL_OR_HASHTAG, BODY_PARA) must be rendered verbatim; do not paraphrase or auto-correct.

# Canonical prompt skeleton

Fill the slots in `{CURLY_BRACES}`. Keep the **INVARIANT BLOCK** verbatim — it is the contract that makes the output match the Promptbase Product Advertising Cards aesthetic.

## Slot list

- `{HEADLINE}` — 1-3 word product/campaign name, verbatim
- `{HEADLINE_TYPE_FAMILY}` — `serif italic display` (luxury/beauty/jewelry/fashion), `bold sans-serif display` (tech/utility/kids/toys/sport), pick from `palettes.md`
- `{HERO_SUBJECT}` — concise, concrete description of the single product subject (e.g., "a single solitaire diamond ring with a round-cut stone in a six-prong gold setting")
- `{HERO_FIDELITY}` — `studio photoreal product render` or `clean stylized 3D render` (kids/toys lean stylized, beauty/jewelry/tech lean photoreal)
- `{BACKGROUND}` — full background phrase from `palettes.md` for the matched category
- `{PARTICLES}` — optional mood overlay (`subtle white sparkles`, `falling snowflakes`, `soft sun rays`, `tiny stars`, or empty)
- `{CALLOUT_TL}`, `{CALLOUT_TR}`, `{CALLOUT_BL}`, `{CALLOUT_BR}` — each is `{ICON_NOUN} | {LABEL}` where `LABEL` is 1-3 words verbatim
- `{ICON_STYLE}` — `thin white line-art glyphs, single weight, inside thin circular outline badges where the label is numeric, plain glyph otherwise`

## Skeleton

```

"Product Advertising Cards" template style.

centered horizontally, very large {HEADLINE_TYPE_FAMILY}, near-white

BACKGROUND: {BACKGROUND}. {PARTICLES}.

  - top-left  : {CALLOUT_TL}

Each callout is {ICON_STYLE} above-or-beside a 1-3 word benefit label in

LIGHTING: soft studio key from upper-left, gentle fill, subtle vignette
at the card edges, radial glow centered on the subject. No harsh shadows.

DO NOT INCLUDE: any watermark, any "@PRINT HAVEN" or seller signature
text, price tags, barcodes, QR codes, secondary logos, body copy
paragraphs, secondary subjects, or any text other than the headline and
the four callout labels listed above. No borders, no frames around the
card itself.

OUTPUT: high-quality finished advertising card ready for social/pin use.
```

# Social Media Ad Poster Template

## Required invariants (verbatim — reproduce in every prompt)

1. **2:3 portrait** ad poster. Output size 1024×1536 (or source-equivalent if Higgsfield clamps).
2. **Single hero product**, centered, 3/4 photographic angle, occupies **55–70% of frame height**. Photoreal product photography only — no illustration, no 3D-render plastic look.
3. **Bold modern sans-serif headline** anchored at the top (or stacked-band middle for `dark-cinematic`), always the largest type element. Headline copy slot: `{HEADLINE}` — quote verbatim in the prompt.
4. **Optional small-caps tagline** above the headline, slot `{TAGLINE}` — quote verbatim. Drops in `dark-cinematic` and `cool-utility` defaults.
5. **Mood-matched background scene** (slot `{BACKGROUND_SCENE}`) drawn from the chosen `{PALETTE_BAND}` — one of `cool-hydration`, `warm-wellness`, `dark-premium`, `dark-cinematic`, `cool-utility` (see `palettes.md`).
6. **One atmospheric layer** (slot `{ATMOSPHERE}`) — water splash, dark bokeh + mist, kitchen scatter, warm cinema lens-flare bokeh, or blurred-room.
7. **Callout layout** chosen from `callout-recipes.md`: `mid-flank-2`, `bottom-corners-2`, `stacked-band`, or `bottom-row-3`. Slots `{CALLOUT_1}`…`{CALLOUT_N}` — 1–3 words each, quote verbatim.
8. **Lighting**: clean studio softbox + mood-matched rim-light. Specular highlights on the hero. Subtle floor reflection or shadow.
9. **Crisp embedded text rendering.** Every quoted slot value must render correctly with no spelling drift. Reinforce with `--no misspellings, no garbled text` constraint at the prompt tail.
10. **No watermark, no QR code, no price tag, no seller signature.** Specifically exclude "DO NOT copy" text — that string belongs to the Promptbase preview overlay, not the design.
11. **Text accuracy contract:** quote `{TAGLINE}`, `{HEADLINE}`, every `{CALLOUT_N}`, and `{RATING_FOOTER}` (when present) verbatim inside the prompt body. The model renders text best when it can read the literal string in the brief.

## Variable slots

| Slot | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `{HERO_SUBJECT}` | string | — | required; describe material, color, angle, label copy if any |
| `{HEADLINE}` | string, 2–5 words | — | required; ALL CAPS by default, Title Case for `cool-utility` |
| `{TAGLINE}` | string, 1–4 words | none | optional preheader; small caps |
| `{PALETTE_BAND}` | enum | category-default | `cool-hydration` / `warm-wellness` / `dark-premium` / `dark-cinematic` / `cool-utility` |
| `{BACKGROUND_SCENE}` | string | band-default (palettes.md) | optional override |
| `{ATMOSPHERE}` | enum | band-default | water-splash / dark-bokeh-mist / kitchen-scatter / cinema-flare / blurred-room |
| `{CALLOUT_LAYOUT}` | enum | band-default (palettes.md) | `mid-flank-2` / `bottom-corners-2` / `stacked-band` / `bottom-row-3` |
| `{CALLOUT_1..N}` | string, 1–3 words | — | required when layout has callouts; with optional tiny line-icon per cell |
| `{ICON_1..N}` | string | inferred from callout | optional explicit icon override |
| `{RATING_FOOTER}` | string | none | optional; five-star row + 3–6 word sentence; only for `mid-flank-2` |
| `{ACCENT_COLOR}` | hex | band-default | optional badge color override (`dark-cinematic` defaults to `#D7263D`) |

## Prompt skeleton

This is the actual engine input. Substitute every `{SLOT}`. Keep the quoted text in double quotes so GPT-Image-2 renders it verbatim.

```
A 2:3 portrait social-media ad poster, photoreal product photography aesthetic.
Hero: {HERO_SUBJECT}, centered, 3/4 angle, occupying ~60% of frame height, sharp focus.
Background: {BACKGROUND_SCENE} with a {ATMOSPHERE} atmospheric layer; mood band = {PALETTE_BAND}.
Lighting: clean studio softbox with mood-matched rim-light, specular highlights on the hero, subtle floor reflection.

Typography:
- Top tagline (small caps thin sans): "{TAGLINE}"            ← omit this line if {TAGLINE} is empty
- Bold headline (heavy modern sans, all caps unless layout says Title Case): "{HEADLINE}"
- Layout: {CALLOUT_LAYOUT}.
  - mid-flank-2 → callout left of hero: tiny line icon over label "{CALLOUT_1}"; callout right of hero: tiny line icon over label "{CALLOUT_2}"; bottom centered five-gold-star row over "{RATING_FOOTER}".
  - bottom-corners-2 → callout bottom-left "{CALLOUT_1}"; callout bottom-right "{CALLOUT_2}"; no rating row.
  - stacked-band → bottom 30% holds 3 stacked rows: thin tagline "{TAGLINE}", saturated lozenge badge with "{HEADLINE}" inside, subtitle "{SUB_FOOTER}".
  - bottom-row-3 → bottom strip with three icon+label cells separated by pipes: "{CALLOUT_1} | {CALLOUT_2} | {CALLOUT_3}".

Color: palette band {PALETTE_BAND} (see palettes.md); accent color {ACCENT_COLOR}.
Constraints: photoreal, crisp text rendering with no misspellings or garbled glyphs, no watermark, no "DO NOT copy" overlay, no QR code, no price tag, no seller signature, no Promptbase or kalekaboom branding.
```

## Render command (Higgsfield primary)

```
backend = higgsfield
model   = gpt_image_2
quality = high     # quality = low only for icon self-test (step 6 of cloner workflow)
aspect  = 2:3      # if Higgsfield asks 3:4, use that and crop to 2:3 in img-tool
```

presets.template:
# Visual Ad Builder - High Conversion Rate Template

Source: Promptbase listing "Visual Ad Builder - High Conversion Rate" by @shaunoftheshed
(`https://promptbase.com/prompt/ad-visual-builder-highconverts`).

This template reproduces the listing's visual contract: a 1:1 photoreal commercial product ad in a lifestyle scene with a top headline, a benefit subheadline, and a rounded pill CTA, color-graded for the product's emotional category.

## Required invariants (verbatim — reproduce in every prompt)

1. **Aspect 1:1 square. Output 1024×1024.** No exceptions. Mobile-first composition: hero occupies 50–65% of canvas; nothing critical within 6% of any edge.
2. **Single hero product** (or product+model co-hero for beauty / activewear) placed naturally in a **lifestyle scene** that matches the product category. Never an isolated pure-white-background product cutout.
3. **Top-anchored headline** containing the product's brand name verbatim. Headline case is category-driven (see slot table). Sans or soft-serif, bold weight, color-graded for legibility against the palette.
4. **Subheadline** directly below the headline: 5–15 words, benefit-driven, sentence-case, ~35–45% of headline weight in the same family.
5. **Rounded pill CTA** in the lower region (bottom-right is most common; bottom-center / mid-right also valid). Filled in a palette-derived color, label in 1–3 words, fully rounded corners (capsule shape), no harsh borders. **Default label "Shop Now".** May be omitted only for premium feature-driven shots that lead with an app/feature line at the bottom.
6. **Palette is mood-matched to the product category** (beauty=peach/coral, tech=jet+electric, food/wellness=warm+wood, activewear=neon, spa=cream/beige, premium=black/ember). Palette is a slot but the *mood-match* is invariant.
7. **Photorealistic commercial photography** rendering — accurate material physics (matte/glossy/textile/glass/ceramic as appropriate), soft directional lighting, color-graded.
8. **No watermarks, no QR codes, no price tags, no extra logos** unless the user explicitly supplies a brand-mark slot (rare; see split-panel variant).
9. **All on-canvas copy is rendered verbatim** from the user's slots — brand name, headline, subheadline, CTA label all reproduced cleanly. No misspellings, no duplicated text, no extra body copy.
10. **Scroll-stopping framing.** Either close-up product hero, mid-distance product-in-context, or model-with-product co-hero. No flat-lay grids, no white catalogue shots.

## Variable slots

| Slot | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `{BRAND_NAME}` | string, 1-3 words | — | required; appears verbatim in headline |
| `{HEADLINE_COPY}` | string, 1-6 words | `{BRAND_NAME}` | required; usually equals brand name OR brand + benefit phrase |
| `{HEADLINE_CASE}` | enum: `title-case`, `all-caps`, `sentence-case` | category-derived | tech / activewear / luxury beauty → all-caps; spa / casual / kids → title-case; service / before-after → sentence-case |
| `{SUBHEADLINE_COPY}` | string, 5-15 words | — | required; benefit-driven sentence |
| `{PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION}` | string, 6-30 words | — | required; physical product (form, materials, color, signature features) |
| `{LIFESTYLE_SCENE}` | string, 4-15 words | — | required; concrete setting (e.g., "light wood kitchen counter with scattered fruit") |
| `{PALETTE}` | enum from `palettes.md` | category-default | optional override |
| `{CTA_LABEL}` | string, 1-3 words | `Shop Now` | optional override (`Get Started`, `Buy Now`, `Order Today`) |
| `{CTA_FILL}` | hex / color name | palette-derived | usually a saturated accent from the palette |
| `{CTA_TEXT_COLOR}` | hex / `white` / `black` | auto-contrast | optional |
| `{CTA_ANCHOR}` | enum: `bottom-right`, `bottom-center`, `mid-right`, `omit` | `bottom-right` | optional; `omit` only for premium feature ads |
| `{LAYOUT_VARIANT}` | enum: `single-panel`, `split-before-after` | `single-panel` | use `split-before-after` for service / transformation ads |
| `{BRAND_MARK}` | string or `none` | `none` | optional small brand-mark lockup (preview-04 style) — only when explicitly supplied |
| `{LIGHTING}` | enum: `soft-directional`, `dramatic-hard-light`, `editorial-window-light`, `dusk-warm`, `studio-rim` | `soft-directional` | optional |

## Prompt skeleton

> Photorealistic 1:1 square commercial product advertisement, 1024x1024, scroll-stopping Instagram and Facebook ad creative.
>
> Hero: {PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION} placed naturally in {LIFESTYLE_SCENE}. The product is the focal element, occupying 50–65% of the canvas height and centered or off-center per the scene's natural framing. Render with photo-real material accuracy and {LIGHTING} lighting that flatters the product and creates soft directional shadows. Mobile-first composition: nothing critical within 6% of any edge.
>
> Top region: bold {HEADLINE_CASE} headline reading exactly "{HEADLINE_COPY}" in a clean modern {TYPOGRAPHY_FAMILY} typeface, color-contrasted against the background for maximum legibility. Directly beneath the headline, a single subheadline line reading exactly "{SUBHEADLINE_COPY}" in the same family at roughly 35–45% of the headline weight, same color family or slightly muted.
>
> Lower region: a fully rounded pill-shaped call-to-action button anchored at the {CTA_ANCHOR}, filled in {CTA_FILL}, with the label exactly "{CTA_LABEL}" in {CTA_TEXT_COLOR} at medium weight. The pill has fully rounded capsule ends, no harsh borders, modest drop-shadow.
>
> Background palette: {PALETTE} — a mood-matched gradient, environment, or surface that supports the product's emotional category without competing visually. Color-grade the entire image to this palette. No clutter. No competing text.
>
> Style: brand-aligned commercial photography, clean professional retouching, color-graded for the product's emotional tone. Layout = {LAYOUT_VARIANT}.
>
> Strict negatives: no watermarks, no QR codes, no price tags, no extra logos, no body text other than what is specified, no extra people unless the lifestyle calls for one model with the product, no broken or duplicated text, no misspellings, no white-background catalogue cutouts.

## Category presets (recommended starting points)

- **Tech / electronics:** all-caps headline, jet-black + electric-blue palette, dramatic-hard-light, CTA on white pill
- **Beauty / skincare:** all-caps headline, peach / blush / cream palette, editorial-window-light, model+product co-hero, CTA on cream pill
- **Activewear / fashion:** all-caps headline + script accent, neon (magenta+cyan) on black, dramatic-hard-light with motion blur, model-in-motion hero, CTA on accent pill
- **Food / kitchen:** title-case headline, warm-wood + accent (green/orange) palette, soft-directional warm light, hand-in-frame engagement, CTA on accent pill
- **Spa / wellness / home fragrance:** title-case headline, cream / oat / beige palette, editorial-window-light, soft props (towels, vases), CTA on cream pill
- **Service / transformation:** sentence-case headline, dusk + fresh-green palette, split-before-after layout, optional brand-mark lockup, CTA on green pill
- **Premium / smart-tech:** all-caps headline, black + ember-orange palette, dramatic-hard-light, app-mockup feature variant, CTA optional

## Anti-patterns (must not appear in output)

- White-background catalogue product cutouts
- Stock-flatlay arrangements with multiple competing products
- Generic "lorem ipsum" or placeholder text rendered into the image
- QR codes, price tags, "ON SALE" starbursts, urgency timers — all out of scope for this style
- Cluttered multi-CTA designs (one CTA only)
- Brand logos other than the supplied {BRAND_MARK} (rare slot)
- Misspelled or duplicated brand name / headline (the most common GPT-Image-2 failure mode for ad creative — flag and retry once)

presets.template:
# Content Carousel Card

> **Higgsfield image selector:** For Higgsfield still-image model choice, model shootouts, credit-sensitive image calls, or still keyframes before video, load `higgsfield-image-generation-playbook` first, then the narrow specialist.

A reusable gpt-image-2 prompt template for high-quality informational social posts: tutorial slides, "concept of the day" cards, product-feature explainers, how-it-works carousels. Designed to look like the modern dev-content carousels circulating on X/LinkedIn/IG (dark navy + glowing constellation, bold rounded type, taped UI mockups).

## Required Signal

Proceed once the user provides at least:

1. **Eyebrow tag** (2 to 5 words, ALL CAPS, e.g. `KARPATHY'S 3-FOLDER STRUCTURE`, `LET CLAUDE WRITE BACK`, `OPEN HOUSE 11/14`).
2. **Headline** (4 to 9 words, 2 to 3 lines when set large). Mark the one phrase that should be in the accent color, e.g. `"three folders. infinite {recall}."` where `{...}` is the accented span.
3. **Subhead** (1 to 3 short sentences, plain explanatory copy). Up to two words may be wrapped in `{...}` to receive accent color.
4. **Mockup spec(s)**: 1 or 2 mockup cards. Each card is one of:
   - `terminal` (dark window chrome, monospaced lines, optional checkmarks/colored prompts)
   - `file-tree` (Obsidian/VS Code style sidebar with folder + file list)
   - `editor` (markdown / code editor view)
   - `chat` (chat-app message bubbles)
   - `document` (markdown rendered, headings + bullets)
   The user provides the content for each mockup verbatim. If not provided, ask once.

Optional inputs: accent color override, palette pairing, aspect ratio override (default 4:5 portrait), logo zone toggle.

If any of the four required fields is missing, ask for it specifically.

## Optional Image Roles

- `style reference` (palette / mood) — accepted to bias the model
- `background reference` (constellation texture) — accepted
- `composition reference` — accepted
- `subject reference` — for a custom mockup screenshot to be redrawn in-style, not embedded raw

## Style Constants (gpt-image-2)

Composition:

- Portrait 4:5 (1024 x 1280) default. Allow 1:1 or 9:16 when requested.
- Vertical zone split, top to bottom:
  1. Top margin band, ~6% canvas height, holds the eyebrow tag in the top-left.
  2. Headline block, ~30% canvas height, left-aligned, headline fills width to ~88% of canvas.
  3. Subhead block, ~12% canvas height, left-aligned, sits below headline with generous leading.
  4. Mockup stack, ~40% canvas height, centered horizontally, 1 or 2 cards stacked with slight rotation and overlap.
  5. Bottom safe margin, ~6% canvas height (reserved for logo composite when brand pack is active).

Background:

- Deep dark navy-to-indigo gradient, top-left slightly lighter than bottom-right. Default color stops: `#1B1733` to `#0E0B1F`.
- Subtle constellation overlay: 40 to 80 tiny soft-white glowing dots of varying size (1px to 4px), with thin 1px lines connecting a handful of them in irregular triangulated clusters. Lines and dots barely visible, not foreground noise.
- Soft radial purple/blue glow blobs (4% to 8% opacity) at two or three off-center points to add depth.
- Subtle vignette darker at the canvas edges.

Typography:

- Headline: bold rounded geometric sans-serif, condensed-to-normal width. Recommended: Sharp Grotesk Bold, Recoleta Bold, Inter Display Black, or Söhne Breit Kräftig. Set tight (-1% to -2% tracking). Mixed case is fine ("let claude write back."), all-lowercase or all-caps both acceptable; never mix in one card.
- Eyebrow tag: ALL CAPS bold sans, ~28px on 1280-tall canvas, white on accent-color rounded rectangle pill, 8% padding, ~14px corner radius.
- Subhead: medium-weight sans (Inter Medium / Söhne Buch), warm white, ~46px headline size scaled to subhead ~38px, generous leading (~1.35).
- Mockup chrome: monospaced for terminals (JetBrains Mono, Berkeley Mono, Menlo). Sans for sidebars/editors (Inter).
- One accent color per card. Default accent is supplied by the user or by the pairing brand pack; in unbranded mode pick a single warm-orange `#FF6B3D` or warm-purple `#9B5DE5` and use it only for the highlighted headline phrase, the eyebrow tag fill, and one or two checkmarks inside a mockup. Never sprinkle the accent across the whole card.

Mockup cards:

- Each card is a slightly rotated rectangle, white or near-white edge (`#F4F2EC` or `#FFFFFF` at ~6% opacity stroke), inner content rendered as a realistic UI screenshot.
- Rotation range: -3 to +4 degrees, alternating between cards when two are stacked.
- Taped corners: two short paper-tape strips (semi-translucent off-white at ~40% opacity) crossing two opposite corners. Tape strips have slight rotation and a soft drop shadow.
- Cards have a soft outer shadow (~24px blur, 25% opacity, pure black) to lift them off the background.
- Inner content matches the user-provided spec verbatim. Render terminal text with the user's exact copy, including the prompt sigil (`>` or `$`), checkmarks (`✓`), and any colored output runs. Do NOT invent copy.
- When two mockups stack, the second card sits below and slightly to the right, overlapping the first by ~10% of its height, giving a "second slide in the deck" feel.

Lighting:

- Soft directional light from upper-left, ~15-degree elevation. Edges of the mockup cards catch a faint highlight on the top-left, deeper shadow on the bottom-right.

Quality:

- Sharp, crisp text rendering. No blur on UI copy. Print-quality detail.
- Constellation dots must not become noise: keep them small, sparse, and concentrated near the headline band and around the mockup stack, never overlapping the headline letterforms.

Negative clause (always include):

- no rival school colors, no neon/gamer aesthetic, no fashion/luxury vibe, no playful/childish illustration, no skewed perspective on mockups beyond -3 to +4 degrees, no glow on the typography, no drop shadow on the headline, no decorative ornaments inside the eyebrow tag, no constellation lines crossing through the headline letterforms, no inventing UI copy not specified by the user, no fake brand logos on mockups (terminal windows can show generic `~/project $` style prompts only).

## Prompt Template

Full assembly template lives at `references/style-template.md`. Read it before assembling the final prompt for the first time in a session.

## Iteration Notes

- If gpt-image-2 invents UI copy, repeat the exact mockup text in quotes inside the prompt and reduce mockup count to 1.
- If the headline accent color bleeds into other words, restate the headline twice in the prompt: once with the full sentence, once with only the accent phrase quoted and color-tagged.
- If the constellation pattern becomes noisy or overlaps the headline, add "constellation dots are sparse and concentrated below the headline only" to the prompt.
- If the mockup rotation looks like a tilted screenshot rather than a taped card, restate the tape strip placement explicitly: "two short translucent paper-tape strips on the top-left and bottom-right corners of each mockup card".
- gpt-image-2 occasionally drops the eyebrow tag entirely on the first generation. Re-roll once before adjusting the prompt.

## Imagegen Handoff

When generation is requested, invoke gpt-image-2 (via OpenAI source `openai.gpt_image_2` or higgsfield's `gpt_image_2` model). Pass the assembled prompt and any optional reference images. Default size: `1024x1280`. Default quality: `high`.

## Handoff Pattern

```text
FINAL GPT IMAGE 2.0 PROMPT:
<assembled prompt from references/style-template.md with user inputs filled in>

INPUT IMAGES:
<none | style reference | background reference | composition reference>

POST-GENERATION:
<none>
```
## Global Error Logging

When this skill is active and a skill-specific step fails while the working directory or any touched artifact is under `<vault>/wiki`, log the failure before retrying, skipping, or stopping.

Use the shared logger:

```bash
python3 ~/.agents/skills/bin/log-skill-error.py \
  --skill "<skill-slug>" \
  --severity "ERROR" \
  --phase "<ingestion|analysis|generation|validation|write|tool>" \
  --tool "<tool or command>" \
  --message "<verbatim non-secret error or concise failure>" \
  --cwd "$PWD" \
  --artifact "<path if any>"
```

Rules:
- Log every non-transient error that affects the outcome, including tool rejection, schema or validation failure, missing auth, missing file, timeout, generation failure, malformed output, or blocked write.
- Preserve the original error string when safe. Do not log credentials, tokens, cookies, bearer headers, or other secrets.
- The logger always appends to `~/.craft-agent/logs/skill-errors.jsonl`. When the current directory or an artifact/source is under the wiki, it also mirrors the record to `<vault>/wiki/_logs/skill-errors.jsonl`.
- Continue normal failure handling after logging. Logging is evidence for repair, not a recovery substitute.

presets.template:
# Hyperrealistic 3D Scientific Specimens Template

> Fidelity is locked. Enhancement is a separate, explicit request after acceptance.

## Unanimous structural invariants

1. Square, front-facing museum-exhibit framing with one isolated biological specimen as the hero. (4/4 previews)
2. The hero is presented above a glossy black circular display plinth with a centered identification plaque. (4/4 previews)
3. White scientific annotation leader lines extend from the specimen to compact labels in the surrounding dark negative space. (4/4 previews)
4. A dark laboratory background, cool blue rim illumination, and restrained warm highlights make the exhibit read as a premium physical object. (4/4 previews)

## Discriminative signatures

### The specimen is a physically plausible transparent resin or glass cutaway containing deeply dimensional, colorful microanatomy.
- Evidence: preview-01.png, preview-02.png, preview-03.png, preview-04.png (4/4 previews)
- Discriminative weight: 5/5
- Prompt clause: physically plausible transparent resin or glass cutaway containing deeply dimensional colorful microanatomy
- Medium/process/substrate: Hyperrealistic 3D scientific-exhibit render · Layered transparent cutaway with internally lit anatomical components · Clear glass or cast resin specimen shell
- Irregularity: not marked purposeful
- Composition exception: The transparent shell may be spherical, ovoid, rounded-rectangular, or a circular sectional disc when required by the specimen.

### The cutaway has tactile micro-scale components such as membranes, folds, organelles, filaments, particles, and molecular textures rather than smooth generic surfaces.
- Evidence: preview-01.png, preview-02.png, preview-03.png, preview-04.png (4/4 previews)
- Discriminative weight: 5/5
- Prompt clause: tactile micro-scale membranes folds organelles filaments particles and molecular textures
- Medium/process/substrate: Hyperrealistic 3D scientific-exhibit render · Dense modeled microanatomy with visible layered depth · Translucent biological materials enclosed by clear resin
- Irregularity: not marked purposeful
- Composition exception: Keep the specimen legible as a single hero object even when internal complexity is dense.

### The black plinth carries an engraved gold or pale-metal plaque with a concise uppercase specimen title and a smaller technical descriptor.
- Evidence: preview-01.png, preview-02.png, preview-03.png, preview-04.png (4/4 previews)
- Discriminative weight: 4/5
- Prompt clause: engraved pale-metal plaque with a concise uppercase specimen title and a smaller technical descriptor
- Medium/process/substrate: Museum display product photography · Precision plaque inset into a layered lacquered plinth · Black lacquered pedestal with metal plaque
- Irregularity: not marked purposeful
- Composition exception: Plaque copy may remain minimal when the specimen requires more annotation space.

## Variable slots

| Slot | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---:|---|---|
| `{SUBJECT}` | scientific specimen | yes | animal cell | The single biological or scientific specimen shown as the hero cutaway. |
| `{SPECIMEN_FORM}` | physical form | yes | spherical cross-section | Use a form appropriate to the specimen, such as an ovoid cross-section or circular sectional disc. |
| `{PLAQUE_TITLE}` | literal short title | yes | ANIMAL CELL | Short uppercase title for the identification plaque. |
| `{TECHNICAL_DESCRIPTOR}` | literal short descriptor | yes | EUKARYOTIC CELL MODEL | Short technical subtitle for the plaque. |

## Model-prior hazards

- **Generic CGI biology illustration** — likely failure: The model produces a flat infographic or a smooth isolated 3D icon instead of a physical exhibit.; countermeasure: Require a physically plausible transparent resin or glass cutaway, tactile micro-scale membranes folds organelles filaments particles and molecular textures, and the glossy black circular display plinth with a centered identification plaque.
- **Unstructured explanatory text** — likely failure: Labels float randomly, obscure the specimen, or become decorative pseudo-text.; countermeasure: Require white scientific annotation leader lines extending to compact labels in the dark negative space; reserve clear dark margins around the hero and keep copy concise.
- **Impossible transparent materials** — likely failure: The shell floats, loses refraction, or has inconsistent reflections and internal occlusion.; countermeasure: State clear glass or cast resin shell, coherent refraction and internal light scatter, physically grounded supports, and contact shadows on the plinth.

## Fidelity-locked prompt skeleton

Create a square, hyperrealistic 3D scientific exhibit photograph of {SUBJECT}, formed as a {SPECIMEN_FORM}. Use square front-facing museum-exhibit framing with one isolated biological specimen. Show a physically plausible transparent resin or glass cutaway containing deeply dimensional colorful microanatomy, with tactile micro-scale membranes folds organelles filaments particles and molecular textures. Mount it on a glossy black circular display plinth with a centered identification plaque. The plaque must read exactly: {PLAQUE_TITLE}; smaller descriptor: {TECHNICAL_DESCRIPTOR}. Add engraved pale-metal plaque with a concise uppercase specimen title and a smaller technical descriptor. Surround the hero with white scientific annotation leader lines extending to compact labels in the dark negative space; labels are clear, concise, and point to real visible structures. Use a dark laboratory background, cool blue rim illumination, and restrained warm highlights. Preserve coherent refraction, internal light scatter, material response, visible support/contact shadows, and a premium educational-exhibit product-photography finish. No watermark, no logo, no extra specimen, no fake UI, no decorative glyphs.

## Optional enhancement boundary

Do not improve, polish, modernize, or reinterpret this skeleton during cloning or ordinary use. After a fidelity-passing render exists, an explicit user request may authorize a separate enhancement variant; keep the accepted fidelity-locked skeleton unchanged.

# Retro Classified Document Template

## Required invariants (verbatim — reproduce in every prompt)

1. Vertical 3:4 frame, output `1024x1536`.
2. Flat-lay top-down photographic camera angle, slight ambient depth, soft overhead diffused light, gentle vignette.
3. A single primary aged manila folder or paper file centered in the frame, occupying ~70-80% of the frame height.
4. Layered loose-leaf typewriter pages and folder edges visibly peeking out at the corners and bottom.
5. Warm sepia-cream paper tone with high-contrast dark typewriter ink. Slight foxing, water stains, scuff marks, dog-eared corners. Tactile aged-paper texture.
6. Top headline reads "{HEADLINE}" — 1 to 3 words, ALL CAPS, mid-century typewriter or rubber-stamp typography, dark ink, prominent.
7. Sub-header reads "{SUBHEADER}" directly under the headline — short single line: file number, branch designation, year, or department.
8. Body text below the sub-header is several short paragraphs of plausible mid-century bureaucratic prose written in typewriter face. AT LEAST ONE LINE of the body is fully redacted with a solid black bar; one or two additional words elsewhere in the body may also be redacted.
9. Wood-grain desk surface visible at the corners and edges of the frame as warm dark amber-brown background.
10. Vintage props on the desk: at least two of — paperclips, vintage postage stamps, scotch or masking tape strips, a small black-and-white photo or ID card, a hand-drawn diagram or seal, a cassette tape, a specimen card, a pressed botanical sample. Use {OPTIONAL_PROPS} as the priority list.
11. Mid-century Cold War era styling, 1950s through 1980s. No modern fonts, modern devices, or contemporary references.
12. Slight film grain. Slight color cast toward warm amber.
13. Optional rubber-stamp text "{STAMP_TEXT}" in red or black ink, angled, partially covering a corner of the document — only if the user supplied a stamp value.
14. **No watermark, no seller signature, no `@sjjdesign` text, no modern logos, no QR codes, no barcodes, no UPC labels.**

## Variable slots

| Slot | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| {HEADLINE} | string, 1-3 words ALL CAPS | yes | the agency / project / file name |
| {SUBHEADER} | string, short line | yes | file number, branch, or year |
| {SUBJECT_THEME} | string | yes | what the document concerns; informs body prose and props |
| {OPTIONAL_PROPS} | comma-list | no | priority prop list; default: paperclips, postage stamps, masking tape |
| {STAMP_TEXT} | string | no | omit unless user supplies — "DECLASSIFIED", "TOP SECRET", "ACTIVE", "CLASSIFIED" |

## Prompt skeleton

```
Vertical 3:4 photograph, flat-lay top-down view of an aged manila folder file lying on a warm dark amber wood-grain desk. Output 1024x1536.

PRIMARY DOCUMENT (centered, ~75% of frame height):
The folder is open or partially open, revealing a stack of mid-century typewriter-printed pages with sepia-cream paper, dog-eared corners, slight foxing and water stains.

The top page reads:
- HEADLINE: "{HEADLINE}" — 1 to 3 words, ALL CAPS, vintage typewriter or rubber-stamp typography, dark ink, large and prominent at the top of the page.
- SUB-HEADER: "{SUBHEADER}" — one short line of typewriter text directly beneath the headline.
- BODY: several short paragraphs of plausible 1950s-1980s bureaucratic prose about {SUBJECT_THEME}, written in typewriter face with monospaced characters. AT LEAST ONE FULL LINE of the body is fully redacted with a solid black censor bar. One or two additional individual words elsewhere in the body are also redacted.

DESK COMPOSITION:
- Layered loose-leaf typewriter pages and folder edges peek out at the corners and bottom of the frame.
- Wood-grain desk surface visible at the four edges as warm dark amber-brown background.
- Vintage props scattered around the document: {OPTIONAL_PROPS}. Place at least two distinct props.
- {STAMP_TEXT_LINE}

LIGHTING & FINISH:
- Soft diffused overhead lighting with a gentle vignette.
- Mid-century Cold War era styling, 1950s through 1980s.
- Slight film grain. Slight warm amber color cast.
- Photographic realism, tactile aged-paper texture.

ABSOLUTELY NO:
- watermark, "@sjjdesign" text, seller signature, QR code, barcode, UPC label, modern logo, modern font, modern device, contemporary reference.
```

`{STAMP_TEXT_LINE}` expands to either:
- omitted entirely if no stamp supplied, OR
- `Optional rubber-stamp impression "{STAMP_TEXT}" in red or black ink, angled at roughly 15-25 degrees, partially covering a top corner of the document, slightly faded and uneven.`

## Recommended prop combos by theme

| Theme | Prop combo |
|---|---|
| UFO / aerospace | paperclips, NASA-era postage stamp, B&W photo of object in sky, hand-drawn trajectory diagram |
| Espionage / psychological | manila clip, two stamps, B&W ID photo of subject, cassette tape |
| Weather / environmental | paperclips, weather-station photo, scotch tape, hand-drawn map fragment |
| Cryptid / occult | masking tape, foreign postage stamp, pressed botanical sample, B&W photo |
| Maritime / underwater | rusty paperclip, blue ink stamp, sonar wheel diagram, weathered photo |
| Medical / containment | paperclips, biohazard ink stamp, specimen card, blurred B&W photo |

## Validation checklist (run after every generation)

- [ ] Aspect = 3:4
- [ ] Flat-lay top-down (not angled)
- [ ] Manila folder + layered papers visible
- [ ] {HEADLINE} renders with correct copy, ALL CAPS, typewriter face
- [ ] {SUBHEADER} renders, readable, one line
- [ ] At least one redacted line visible
- [ ] Wood-grain edge visible at corners
- [ ] At least 2 vintage props visible
- [ ] No "@sjjdesign" or any other watermark
- [ ] No modern objects, fonts, or logos
- [ ] Sepia-cream paper + warm amber color cast

If 2+ items fail, run one targeted retry with the failing items called out explicitly. After two retries, surface to user.
