# 80s Arcade Game Ads Template

Source: Promptbase listing **80s Arcade Game Ads** by `@studioprompt` (paywalled, prompt hidden). Triangulated from 9 source previews + cover.

## Required invariants (verbatim — reproduce in every prompt)

1. **2:3 portrait** poster, full-bleed. Output 1024×1536 (or source-aspect equivalent).
2. **Hero count: 1.** One hero or one hero-vs-antagonist tableau in the middle 50-60% of the canvas. Painted/airbrushed cartoon-realism, dynamic mid-action pose, dramatic rim lighting, slight forced perspective.
3. **Display title** at the top, 1-3 words, all caps, chrome / airbrushed / extruded-3D 80s arcade lettering, optional secondary subtitle in smaller weight or contrasting hot color directly beneath. Title quoted verbatim from `{GAME_TITLE}`.
4. **Tagline** in upper-mid or lower body, all caps, second-largest text on the canvas, hot accent color. Quoted verbatim from `{TAGLINE}`.
5. **Bullet list of 2-4 short feature lines**, each 1-4 words, all caps, exclamation-heavy, stacked or arranged in a panel above the CTA. Quoted verbatim from `{BULLET_1}…{BULLET_N}`.
6. **CTA line** near the bottom, all caps, exclamation-marked. Quoted verbatim from `{CTA}`.
7. **Aged paper / cabinet-flyer background texture** — yellowed off-white base, halftone print dot pattern, faint scratches, registration offset, mild chromatic aberration on title edges. Reads as a 40-year-old promo, not pristine.
8. **Neon 80s palette** — 2-3 dominant hues from `{hot pink, magenta, electric cyan, teal, lemon yellow, sunset orange, deep purple, lime green, chrome silver}`. At least one neon hot must dominate the title or the rim lighting.
9. **Type families.** Title: chrome / airbrush / extruded-3D 80s arcade display (Galaxian / Outrun / R-Type lineage). Body: condensed bold sans-serif, all caps. No modern geometric sans, no serif body, no script.
10. **No watermark, no seller signature, no QR codes, no real-brand logos, no modern UI chrome.** Optional fictional publisher footer ("COMING SUMMER {YEAR} — {PUBLISHER}") allowed when slot filled.

## Variable slots

| Slot | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| {GAME_TITLE} | string, 1-3 words, all caps | — | required |
| {SUBTITLE} | string, 1-3 words, all caps | none | optional, second line of title block |
| {HERO_SUBJECT} | string | — | required; the painted hero (e.g. "lone ninja in red", "cyborg gorilla mid-roar") |
| {SCENE_SETTING} | string | "neutral neon arena" | optional environment cue |

| {BULLET_1..N} | string, 1-4 words each, all caps | — | 2-4 bullets, required |
| {CTA} | string, all caps, exclamation-marked, 2-4 words | "INSERT COINS NOW!" | bottom-of-poster |
| {YEAR} | 4-digit integer 1980-1989 | — | optional footer |
| {PUBLISHER} | string, fake game studio | — | optional footer |
| {PALETTE} | one of palettes.md entries | "magenta-cyan-yellow" | overrides default neon mix |

## Prompt skeleton (engine input)

```
A 1980s coin-op arcade cabinet promotional flyer poster, 2:3 portrait, full-bleed, painted in the airbrushed cartoon-realism style of Bob Wakelin and Marc Ericksen.

TITLE BLOCK (top third): the words "{GAME_TITLE}" rendered as a massive chrome / extruded-3D / airbrushed 80s arcade display title, all caps, with subtle chromatic aberration on the edges.{SUBTITLE_BLOCK}

HERO ART (middle 50-60%): {HERO_SUBJECT}, dramatic mid-action pose, bold rim lighting from a hot neon source, slight forced perspective. Setting: {SCENE_SETTING}. Painted in airbrushed cartoon-realism with high contrast, glossy highlights, and crisp linework.

COPY BLOCK (lower 30-40%):
- Tagline in second-largest type, all caps, in a contrasting hot neon color: "{TAGLINE}"
- A panel of {N} bullet features, each 1-4 words, all caps, exclamation-heavy, stacked or two-column:
  • "{BULLET_1}"
  • "{BULLET_2}"
  • "{BULLET_3}"
  • "{BULLET_4}"
- Closing CTA at the bottom, all caps, big and loud: "{CTA}"
{PUBLISHER_FOOTER}

PALETTE: {PALETTE} — high-saturation 80s neon. At least one of {hot pink, electric cyan, lemon yellow, sunset orange, deep purple, lime green} dominates the title and the rim lighting.

TEXTURE: aged off-white cabinet-flyer paper, faint halftone print dots, light scratches, slight registration offset, edges very subtly worn.

TYPE RULES: title family is chrome / airbrush / extruded-3D 80s arcade display. Body and bullets are condensed bold sans-serif, all caps. No modern geometric sans-serif, no serif body, no script.

EXCLUDE: watermarks, seller signatures, QR codes, real brand logos, modern UI chrome, photorealistic faces, modern fonts.

Render every quoted text string verbatim, exactly as written, with no paraphrase.
```

`{SUBTITLE_BLOCK}` expands to ` Directly beneath, a smaller subtitle "{SUBTITLE}" in a contrasting hot color.` when filled, else empty string.

`{PUBLISHER_FOOTER}` expands to `\n- Tiny publisher footer in a corner: "COMING {SEASON} {YEAR} — {PUBLISHER}"` when filled, else empty string.

`{N}` is the count of filled bullets (2-4).

## Prompt skeleton

## Guardrails

- ALWAYS render the landing page front-facing and straight-on: no angled slab, no isometric perspective, no 3D perspective skew, no rotated browser, no concept-art camera angle. The output must look like a screenshot a developer can rebuild into HTML/CSS.
- Do not include Promptbase, seller watermarks, QR codes, price stickers, purchase buttons, or marketplace UI.
- Do not use copyrighted real logos unless the user explicitly supplies rights-cleared brand material.
